wonders.name: Ancient Cave
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] per <quarry></quarry> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.STORMSCALE_SERPENT]Stormscale Serpent[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PLAGUE_SERPENT]Plague Serpent[/hyperlink] units to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>An ancient cavern that heralds from the time of this world's creation, during an era when Dragons and Giants molded the very lands into physical form. Within these natural sanctuaries, the first creatures found shelter as the world outside violently settled into place. To this day, the cave itself remains a sanctuary for those that are able to find their way to it.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: Lair of Silk
text: The cave is dark and eerily silent as you approach. A thin layer of silky webbing covers the entrance.

You and your party venture further through the maze-like cave, passing cocoons filled with all sorts of creatures whilst searching for the secrets hidden beneath the cobwebs. Before long, the webbing gets so thick that it becomes noticeably harder to move. Then, you hear something in the darkness.
While you struggle to move through the sticky web, you hear the excited chitter of the cave's many-legged inhabitants. They can sense more prey!

options.text: "Slay these vile creatures! Attack!"
Set fire to the webbing around you.
Collapse part of the cave on top of the spiders, damaging them before engaging.

check.header: Attempt to crush the spiders under falling rocks
check.success: A part of the cave collapses onto the spiders, damaging them.
check.failure: A part of the cave collapses... around <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>!

options.text: Retreat.

aftermath.title: Lair of Silk: Aftermath
text: After the spiders are dealt with, you can search the cave with ease.

You find several cocoons, most of them empty or with their contents decayed. Then, one of your companions calls you over. "This one's still breathing!" You quickly free the living victim and after a moment of respite, <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> is able to speak. "Thank the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] for your arrival. My name is <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> of <eventColor>their House</eventColor>. We traveled here to investigate this so-called safe haven, and then... well." <eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> gestures towards the cocoons.
"I owe you my life, o <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>." <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> says. "If you need my help in the future, you need only ask."

options.text: Send <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> home <goodact></goodact> to <eventColor>their House</eventColor>.
Strip <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> of their belongings <gold></gold> and imprison <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>. <evilact></evilact>
Send <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> home <goodact></goodact> to <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Demand tribute <gold></gold> for the rescue and send <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> on their way.

stories.title: Cave of Carnage
text: As you approach the cave, you smell fresh blood, but find no signs of life.

Having entered the cave, you and your companions find the remains of a brutal fight. The carcass of an adult <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> lies alongside her offspring; the two of them appear to have been ambushed in what was supposed to be a safe haven. Upon closer inspection, it looks as though the animals were viciously attacked by a wild <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor>.
You freeze when an ear-piercing shriek resounds through the cave and the same bloodthirsty <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> emerges from the dark, their rabid eyes fixed on you...

options.text: "No time to waste! Attack!"
Feed the beast <food></food> until it can barely move, then attack.
Try and calm the crazed <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> before putting it down.

check.header: Attempt to calm the blood-crazed <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor>
check.success: The confidence:EnemyUnit wavers.
check.failure: The beast attacks with even more fervor.

options.text: Flee.

aftermath.title: Cave of Carnage: Aftermath
text: The wild threat has been dealt with and you have the opportunity to search the cave.

You order the bodies of the <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> and her offspring to be removed. As others go to lift the heavy animal, something softly whines from underneath it — and a young <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> emerges, the sole survivor of the pack. It seems as though its mother's body protected it from harm. It looks up to you and whines again.
A young <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> has survived the carnage at the Ancient Cave and clings to you.

options.text: Keep the <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> and raise it as your mount. <mount></mount>
Nurse the <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> to strength and release it into the wild. <goodact></goodact>
The hide of this <eventColor>White Wolf</eventColor> would make a for a very fine <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item>...

stories.title: Pit of Vipers
text: As soon as you enter the Ancient Cave, you notice it is infested with snakes.

Stony serpents loom like pillars in the heart of the underground maze. The entire scene looks like a shrine dedicated to an outlawed deity. Ornate rock formations surround a stone-shaped altar, where the idol of a snake-haired woman stands. The living serpents lurk at a distance, until you touch the altar. The idol grins and crumbles, the snakes hissing in anticipation.
A hollow echo shakes the cavern: "Disssciplesss of the Gorgon Goddesss, choossse your sssacrificcce... Lessst you find your greedy heartsss turned to ssstone."

options.text: "I'm not afraid of any goddess or her slithering guardians. To arms!"
"I offer the people <population></population> of <eventColor>your city</eventColor> <evilact></evilact> to feed thy protectors."
Stone magic is one of your strengths. Use it to predict the targets of the Gorgon's Curse.

check.header: Predict the petrifying curse
check.success: The curse holds no secrets for you.
check.failure: The goddess' curse remains a mystery.

options.text: Retreat.

aftermath.title: Pit of Vipers: Aftermath
text: Having survived the trial of the Gorgon Goddess, a shifting stone plate reveals her chamber of offerings.

Inside the hidden room, a line of petrified adventurers bears silent witness to the magic of the Curse you withstood. You find a scroll created by the old worshipers of the Gorgon Goddess, which seems to contain a litho-shaping spell.
Do you keep the scroll of litho-shaping or use it to revive the petrified victims you found?

options.text: "Their time has passed. The scroll <knowledge></knowledge> will help me in future battles."
"Bring the victims to life! They are free to return to their homes <influence></influence>." <goodact></goodact>
"Revive the victims of the curse! My army <unit></unit> can use these <eventColor>Young Caustic Worms</eventColor>!"

wonders.name: Barren Wellspring
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+1 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.GRIMBEAK_CROW]Grimbeak Crow[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Unlocks the Restore action which turns this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HIDDEN_WELLSPRING]Hidden Wellspring[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: For whatever unnatural reason, the endless waters of this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HIDDEN_WELLSPRING]Hidden Wellspring[/hyperlink] that used to flow from the Fey realm have dried up, causing cascading disruptions to the magical harmony that it once sustained. The drought has turned fertile fields of green into arid wastelands, where all things wither except for chaos and turmoil.

stories.title: Dammed Diversion
text: You are drawn to the Barren Wellspring by the metallic sounds of tools and machinery. A siege workshop is built here.

Industrious mercenaries have dammed the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HIDDEN_WELLSPRING]Hidden Wellspring[/hyperlink] that originates here, diverting its endless waters to power a manufactory of siege engines. The drained, dry lake bed is defenseless against the whims of the harsh winds. Hazardous sandstorms, whipped up by the raging winds, sweep across the barren desert. A War Golem bellows commands at chained workers, whipping them with their <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.
The dammed Wellspring allows the War Golem to produce vast quantities of <eventColor>War Golems</eventColor> in the Barren Wellspring. Will you stand for this?

options.text: Attack the industrious bandits.
Call laborers <structureprod></structureprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor> to sabotage the siege manufactory.
Stoke the fires that drive the siege constructs.

check.header: Seek to overheat the engines of the siege machines:
check.success: The <eventColor>War Golems</eventColor> become volatile and will explode upon destruction.
check.failure: The craftsmanship of the bandits outclasses your fires of chaos.

options.text: Assume control over the raging sandstorms.

check.header: Steer the winds to immobilize the sandstorm:
check.success: The sandstorms obey your command and remain in place.
check.failure: The sandstorms break free from your hold.

options.text: Allow the bandits to continue their work for now.

aftermath.title: Dammed Diversion: Aftermath
text: After the battle against the War Golem and their <eventColor>War Golems</eventColor>, you inspect the siege workshop and the dam.

You aren't sure if the War Golem was creating the <eventColor>War Golems</eventColor> for other lords, or if the War Golem was building an army for themselves. <eventColor>War Golems</eventColor> cautiously walk out of the siege workshop, captured by the mercenaries and forced to work the machinery. They deliver harrowing testimonies about the War Golem's cruelty and their chortling while the War Golem would flay them with their <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.
Tools recovered from the workshop will help <eventColor>your city</eventColor>'s laborers. The Barren Wellspring potentially harbors another boon to support your war efforts.

options.text: Salvage unused bronze and steel for <eventColor>your city</eventColor>'s forges. <unitprod></unitprod>
Complete the production of a War Golem. <unit></unit>
Enlist <unit></unit> the freed <eventColor>War Golems</eventColor>.
Find the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> that the War Golem wielded.
Break the dam to honor Nature. <natureboon></natureboon>

stories.title: Dried Up Disarray
text: You arrive at a Barren Wellspring, expecting to quench your thirst. Instead, you are met by hostile <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> rampaging about.

An elemental imbalance has dried up the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.HIDDEN_WELLSPRING]Hidden Wellspring[/hyperlink] that is normally lush with life. On the barren lake bed, various [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL]Elementals[/hyperlink] lash out against any interlopers. It is a primordial battle to decide what element will persevere and take over the Barren Wellspring. You witness how an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> is incinerated by an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>, but then turns into an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> to resume the fight.
Unless someone intervenes, this battle can know no end. Will you step up and harmonize the elements of the Barren Wellspring?

options.text: Attack the Elementals to restore balance to the Barren Wellspring.
Deharmonize <mana></mana> the tumultuous nature of the attacking Elementals.
Reseed the Barren Wellspring.

check.header: Bring back vegetation to the Barren Wellspring:
check.success: Lush plant life provides newly grown cover for your army.
check.failure: The Barren Wellspring has become too infertile for even your command over Nature.

options.text: Disrupt the <eventColor>land</eventColor> revealed by the drained Barren Wellspring.

check.header: Manipulate the <eventColor>land</eventColor> laid bare by the dry Barren Wellspring:
check.success: The <eventColor>lands</eventColor> hinder the movement of the Elementals.
check.failure: The elemental imbalance nullifies your attempted disruption.

options.text: Disrupt the <eventColor>land</eventColor> revealed by the drained Barren Wellspring.

check.header: Manipulate the <eventColor>land</eventColor> laid bare by the dry Barren Wellspring:
check.success: The <eventColor>lands</eventColor> hinder the movement of the Elementals.
check.failure: The elemental imbalance nullifies your attempted disruption.

options.text: Disrupt the <eventColor>land</eventColor> revealed by the drained Barren Wellspring.

check.header: Manipulate the <eventColor>land</eventColor> laid bare by the dry Barren Wellspring:
check.success: The <eventColor>lands</eventColor> hinder the movement of the Elementals.
check.failure: The elemental imbalance nullifies your attempted disruption.

options.text: Escape the unstable Elements' rage.

aftermath.title: Dried Up Disarray: Aftermath
text: You have overcome the elemental imbalance caused by the Barren Wellspring's drought.

The hostile [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL]Elementals[/hyperlink] were warped, twisted, and driven mad by the magical disruption that the dried up Wellspring wrought. Now that their physical manifestations are shattered, the dry lake bed is covered in mana crystals, which your warriors dutifully collect.
By restoring balance to the Barren Wellspring, it now has a chance to heal. Some Elementals' remains can be repurposed for boons.

options.text: Restore one shattered <eventColor>Random Elemental</eventColor> <unit></unit> to fight for you.
Gather the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>'s remains to fuel <eventColor>your city</eventColor>'s forges. <unitprod></unitprod>
Collect the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>'s remains to fertilize <eventColor>your city</eventColor>'s fields. <food></food>
Pick up the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>'s remains to build <eventColor>your city</eventColor>'s structures. <structureprod></structureprod>
Drain the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>'s remains to boost your majesty. <influence></influence>

wonders.name: Breached Arcanum
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Adds one or more unknown [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink] based on the Arcanum's surrounding environment.</bullet><bullet>Can be restored to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SHROUDED_ARCANUM]Shrouded Arcanum[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: The epitome of the Shrouded Isles; a Wizard Tower steeped in secret and experimental magic, hidden from the prying gaze of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink]. They were created as a subterfuge to elude the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Circle of Deogai[/hyperlink], established by those very divine guardians. Nevertheless, this specific structure has been looted and stripped of most of its value.

pool: All non-tier 5 Ethereal Units (Except Astral Sea Monsters)
All Astral Enchantments Except Tier V
stories.title: Breached Arcanum
text: This Arcanum has been stripped of most of its value; its knowledge stolen, its resources plundered.

Several figures still stand guard over the structure, among them a <eventColor>Moon Guardian</eventColor>. Healed scars and bruises cover the bodies of the guardians, who seem to have only just recovered from a recent defeat—perhaps at the hands of those who looted this place. Whatever their condition, they rise before you, determined to protect the Arcanum.
The guardians of the isle remain vigilant, ensuring the structure does not fall into the wrong hands. If you wish to claim it, you will have to defeat them.

options.text: Attack the guardians.
Leave the place for now.

wonders.name: Castle Ruins
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] per <quarry></quarry> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.QuarryConcept]Quarry[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Can be set as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] deploy location.</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BREWER_OGRE]Brewer Ogre[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BUTCHER_OGRE]Butcher Ogre[/hyperlink] units to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>The ruins of a massive stronghold dating back to an age when the first civilizations made a stand against rampant, gargantuan monsters and magical storms. Although battered, its weathered walls still offer a degree of protection to those within as well as those nearby during times of strife.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: Smoke and Ruins
text: As you approach the smoking ruins of a once proud castle, you notice a faded sigil above the charred gate.

Through the ages, this keep has been home to many beasts and vagabonds, leaving it in ruins. You smell smoke as you enter the gate. A red glow illuminates the corridors close to the courtyard where cackling laughter and fearful screaming can be heard. There you see the dancing shadows of a Pyromancer and their followers. They are setting several pyres ablaze, to which frightened animals are tied.
It seems as though a band of pyromaniacs have claimed this heap of stone, and are now spending their time setting captured wildlife ablaze.

options.text: Attack the firestarters!
Use your magical prowess <mana></mana> to protect yourself and your army from the blaze before entering.
Channel water to douse the flames before entering.

check.header: Attempt to douse the fires:
check.success: The pyromaniacs are shocked as their flames are doused!
check.failure: You kindle the flames instead of dousing them.

options.text: Leave.

aftermath.title: Smoke and Ruins: Aftermath
text: With the pyromaniacs gone, you and your companions are free to search the rest of the ruins.

Your soldiers free the tormented animals, who quickly flee the keep. Upon further inspection You notice that the pyromancers left behind stashes of scorched loot throughout the building. Among it you discover a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>, engraved with the same sigil as you saw above the castle gate. It looks very valuable once you have wiped away the soot.
The <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> you have discovered seems to belong to <eventColor>their House</eventColor>.

options.text: Finders, keepers. <item></item>
Return the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> to <eventColor>their House</eventColor>.
Display the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> in <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.

stories.title: Castles and Captives
text: You approach the castle carefully. It seems abandoned, but distraught voices can be heard from within the castle walls.

Inside, you notice caged animals and a group of scared captives, bound and guarded by captors led by an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>. The latter sees <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> and bows, grinning slyly. "Ah, a customer!" the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> says. "Welcome to our humble merchant caravan."
"We are merely traders of a... specific livestock. Are you interested in our merchandise?"

options.text: Attack the captors!
"I will buy <gold></gold> your stock. All of it."
Destroy the locks on the animals' cages before engaging the captors.

check.header: Attempt to free the caged animals before attacking the captors:
check.success: The animals are released and cause chaos!
check.failure: You are stopped by the "merchants" before you can liberate their merchandise.

options.text: "You had better flee before you invoke the wrath of the spirits haunting this keep!"

check.header: Attempt to intimidate the slavers by invoking roaming spirits:
check.success: The slavers panic and attack.
check.failure: The slavers scoff at your ghost story and attack with gusto.

options.text: Leave.

aftermath.title: Castles and Captives: Aftermath
text: The slavers are gone and the surviving captives flock around you appreciatively yet anxiously.

From amidst the captives, an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> of the <eventColor>race</eventColor> steps forward and bows deeply. "We are civilians under the protection of <eventColor>their House</eventColor>." the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> says. "We were ambushed on the roads near this castle and brought here... What do you plan to do with us, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>?"
The captives from <eventColor>their House</eventColor> anxiously await their fate.

options.text: Capture the civilians yourself <evilact></evilact>, intimidating <eventColor>their House</eventColor>. Surprise!
Release the civilians to return to <eventColor>their House</eventColor>.
"My soldiers <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor> will escort you home to <eventColor>their House</eventColor>." <goodact></goodact>
"Soldiers <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor> will escort you home." <goodact></goodact>
Send the civilians on their way.

stories.title: Salt and Vinegar
text: Scouting the castle, you witness a rather morbid argument.

"We steam them with mushrooms!" you hear the deep voice of a Butcher Ogre say. "More creamy that way!"

"No!" another voice that sounds the same disagrees. "We cook little race in butter!"

"You idiot!" yet another of them yells. "We roast them with vinegar!"

None of them listen to the protests of their "ingredients," a group of race cowering in a corner.
Will you interfere before the Butcher Ogre and their comrades have agreed how to best cook their captives?

options.text: "To the rescue! Attack!"
Appease the Butcher Ogre and their comrades with cattle <food></food> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Fan the flames of their argument until they turn on each other...

check.header: Attempt to imitate the <eventColor>Brewer Ogre</eventColor>'s voice to escalate the debate:
check.success: The <eventColor>Unit</eventColor> and his comrades attack each other in a blind rage.
check.failure: The ruse is discovered. Now <eventColor>Unit</eventColor> very angry!

options.text: Leave.

aftermath.title: Salt and Vinegar: Aftermath
text: With the hungry brutes no longer a threat, you can rescue their traumatized victims.

"It was all my fault, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>!" their leader, a <eventColor>Brewer Ogre</eventColor>, explains. "These merchants trusted us to protect them, but, two days ago, those monstrous cannibals overwhelmed us at nightfall."
"We are indebted to you, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. Everyone in this company owes you their lives - how can we repay you?"

options.text: "Market your goods <structureprod></structureprod> at <eventColor>your city</eventColor> and we will all reap the benefits of this adventure."
"Your craft chest <gold></gold> is what I am interested in..."
"Join my army, <eventColor>Brewer Ogre</eventColor>, and you can redeem yourself in combat."

stories.title: Heroes and Horrors
text: As you enter the Castle Ruins, you feel incomprehensible dread. Slowly, you crouch closer.

In the courtyard, a shadowy creature moves with unnatural grace. The enemy touches the ground which groans in protest. A flickering light rises from it... The enemy grasps the light and pulls it into themselves.
You realize this is an enemy from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], a being that, according to folklore, feeds on magic and lost [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink]...
You realize that many souls will be freed upon the defeat of the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>.

options.text: "No time to waste! This <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> must be stopped!"
Channel raw magical prowess <mana></mana> to weaken the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> before attacking.
Call upon your knowledge of the arcane to weaken the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>'s link to this realm.

check.header: Attempt to banish the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>
check.success: The creature howls in agony.
check.failure: The creature notices you and attacks.

options.text: Leave the Castle Ruins.

aftermath.title: Heroes and Horrors: Aftermath
text: Light bursts from the defeated monsters' wounds, tiny darts of energy zigzagging into the sky toward freedom.

You take a short moment to look at the fleeting lights before shifting your gaze downward again. Many bodies lie strewn across the ruins. A few of the lights float to the bodies, as if saying goodbye, before disappearing into the sky. Two of them waver, floating nearby. They seem to want to lead you to their possessions.
Two freed souls linger, wishing to lead you to their mortal possessions out of gratitude before they move on. Which of them do you follow?

options.text: Follow the soul of the merchant, who offers his savings <gold></gold>.
Follow the soul of the commander, who fell wielding a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item>.
Quickly claim these freed souls for yourself. <evilact></evilact>
"Saving lost souls is its own reward. I ask for nothing else." <goodact></goodact>

stories.title: Gold and Gladiators
text: While traveling past a hill crowned with the vestiges of a ruined castle, you hear the remote echo of a cheering crowd. You move closer to investigate.

The ruins open out into a makeshift fighting arena. In the gap formed by a broken wall stands a group of <eventColor>race</eventColor>, led by a ringmaster, gesturing at you. "A noble <eventColor>Leader</eventColor> graces us with <eventColor>your</eventColor> presence! Welcome, bloodthirsty onlooker!" The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> smiles with a mouth missing most of its teeth. "I run this mobile fighting establishment. The toughest gladiators bring home the gold!" The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> holds up a pouch filled with coins.
The ringmaster proclaims: "Join the carnage, defeat my [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink], and win the gold! Or use those pretty legs to run straight back home."

options.text: "I will show all of you what you are dealing with."
Make a wager <gold></gold> that you will win, encouraging your army.
Leave the arena.

aftermath.title: Gold and Gladiators: Aftermath
text: You were victorious against a band of fierce gladiators. The ringmaster grins and weaves their way past expired combatants.

"Amazing! By the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink], I haven’t seen that sort of fighting in ages!" The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> pats the fat coinpurse on their belt. Coins jingle. "I suppose you expect payment, my <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>." The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> looks around and says, "Pack up, boys! The Castle Ruins has a new owner, and <eventColor>your</eventColor> name is <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>." The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> grins at <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> while their underlings mutter and leave.
"Here’s your cut of the winnings, now we'll take our leave..." The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> says, holding out a much smaller bag of coins.

options.text: Demand all the gold you are owed before allowing the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> to leave. <gold></gold>
"I could use your fighters to instruct my soldiers in <eventColor>your city</eventColor>." <unitprod></unitprod>
"I ask your strongest champion to join me <unit></unit>."
"I ask your strongest champion to join me <unit></unit> in the future."
"Illegal arenas are a blight. Best you leave before the law <order></order> catches up with you."

stories.title: Wrath and Mutiny
text: Before you can enter a bandit-infested fortress, you are stopped by a whistle from nearby.

A coarse-looking woman appears from behind a broken wall. "Hey, psst, my <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>! I see you're tryin' to enter my old camp. I used to lead the gang of idiots in there. But, after our last raid, they booted me out! Mutiny! Hey, if you teach them a lesson, I'll gladly point you to our secret stash of loot. Sharin' the spoils, y'know?"
The rugged stranger grins, keeping their distance. "Those bastards laid out traps. I can help you find them. Scratch my back and I'll scratch yours, whaddaya say?"

options.text: "I don't need help from brigands like you, I'll clear these ruins myself." <goodact></goodact>
Allow the bandit "leader" to reveal the traps before entering the ruins.
Figure out where the traps are using your knowledge of stone and architecture.

check.header: Figure out where the traps would logically be.
check.success: You reveal the traps the bandits have set!
check.failure: FAILURE: You know there are traps, but you don't know where...

options.text: Leave the bandit and her former crew.

aftermath.title: Wrath and Mutiny: Aftermath
text: After dealing with the den of bandits, you can search the ruins. You're quickly joined by the former bandit leader.

The stranger sighs as <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> sees the bodies of their former comrades. "Shame. They were decent cronies, while it lasted." <eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> leads you to a secret room, hidden behind a stone slab. "Anyways, here's the stash. Some fine loot too, even a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>... The name's <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> by the way. Should our paths cross again."

<eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> leads you to a room filled with bandit loot. "Ta-dah. I'll leave you to it..." <eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> quickly fills their pockets with gold and attempts to leave.

options.text: Allow your soldiers to loot what they want. <morale></morale>
Claim all the loot <gold></gold> for the empire.
"I could use a bold leader <unit></unit> like you on my side, <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>."
"I could use a bold leader <unit></unit> like you in the future, <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>."
"Not so fast! You will be tried <order></order> for your crimes and these stolen goods confiscated."

wonders.name: Crimson Fane
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] per <researchpost></researchpost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept]Research Post[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SHRIEKING_BAT]Shrieking Bat[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>If <thralls></thralls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ThrallConcept]Thralls[/hyperlink] are available, the <thralls></thralls> Thrall Sacrifice action on this structure becomes available to permanently gain +10 <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink] and +10 <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink] from this structure.</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Within dark and forgotten holes that pierce the realm's surface, ominous gates lead to shadowed shrines. Here, unspeakable horrors fester and develop at the hands of mad cultists and the forsaken. Even more unsettling than the metallic stench of blood that rises from these profane pits are the maddening screams and screeches that echo from darkness within.

stories.title: Echoes of Insanity
text: You step into the dark of the Crimson Fane and are welcomed by high-pitched shrieks bouncing off the cavern walls.

<eventColor>Shrieking Bats</eventColor>, bred by a deranged Chaplain, are the source of the shrieks. You witness in horror how the Chaplain offers their arms to the <eventColor>Shrieking Bats</eventColor>, who willingly drink their blood. "Drink up, my pets," the Chaplain cries through agony. "Drink and I shall soon be an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ElderVampireLoreConcept]Elder Vampire[/hyperlink]!" The Chaplain then becomes aware of your presence and withdraws their arm.
The Chaplain, as blind as their bats, steps towards you menacingly. Their bloodthirsty <eventColor>Shrieking Bats</eventColor> follow suit. How will you proceed?

options.text: Clip the bat wings! Attack!
Confuse the bats by the clanking of laborer's tools <structureprod></structureprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Transform the cavern walls to dampen its acoustics.

check.header: Negate the echoes that bounce off the cave walls:
check.success: Your army's resolve grows against the <eventColor>Shrieking Bats</eventColor>.
check.failure: Your transmutation attempts have no effect.

options.text: Flee the bat cave.

aftermath.title: Echoes of Insanity: Aftermath
text: The deafening screeches that echoed through the Crimson Fane are silenced. Blood floods the guano-coated cave floor.

Some of the <eventColor>Shrieking Bat</eventColor> pups were spared from the slaughter. You discover that the delusions of the Chaplain ran deeper you thought. Moldy tomes and wall scribbles describe rituals and processes concerning vampirism and bat anatomy. Although the notion of <eventColor>Shrieking Bats</eventColor> transforming mortals into [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ElderVampireLoreConcept]Elder Vampires[/hyperlink] remains preposterous, the experiments might yield valuable new insights.
After copying the research notes, what else will <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> take from the cleared Crimson Fane?

options.text: Scrape the bat droppings from the floor, to fertilize your fields. <food></food>
Rear a <eventColor>Shrieking Bat</eventColor> <unit></unit> to fight for you.
Mount a <eventColor>mount</eventColor> <item></item> to fly you into battle.

stories.title: Bloodletter's Tenets
text: You march into the scent of warm blood wafting from the maw of the Crimson Fane, pelted by harrowing screams and chittering.

Leading your army inside, you witness how <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> expose their bodies to <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>, who rapaciously drain their blood. Bloated <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> writhe on the cavern floor, laying eggs. Shapes move underneath the skin of the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>, who cry arcane chants about blood purity and the Bloodletter's Tenets. Their screams reveal no agony, only exaltation.
They notice you when a stray <eventColor>Blood Cultist</eventColor> attempts to latch onto your leg. The frenzied <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> immediately move to attack.

options.text: Expedite the bloodletting of the misguided <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>. Attack!
Infect <hp></hp> your troops with Blood Parasites to share the cultists' boon.
Corrupt your flesh to repel the voracious Blood Parasites.

check.header: Enchant your army to deter the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> from drinking your blood:
check.success: The <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> are less likely to inject blood parasites in your warriors.
check.failure: The bloodthirst of the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> transcends your foul tasting flesh.

options.text: Invoke the primal urges of all newly hatched <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>.

check.header: Negate whatever sway the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> have over the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>:
check.success: Newly hatched <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> attack their willing hosts first.
check.failure: Nature cannot overcome the manipulation of the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>.

options.text: Retreat. Leave these wretched <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> to their crazed rituals for now.

aftermath.title: Bloodletter's Tenets: Aftermath
text: Upon slaying the last of the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor>, you discover the true purpose the Crimson Fane: it is an altar to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept]Urvatogh[/hyperlink].

You discover tomes that mention the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrvatoghLoreConcept]Deathless God[/hyperlink], and his so-called Bloodletter's Tenets. The power of the dark entity had infected the minds of the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> with the broken belief that offering their blood to the <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> would lead to greatness and the First Vampire's return. Their repeated rites amassed unpredictable magical energies, which you quickly precipitate as mana.
<eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> flee the Crimson Fane. Is there anything worth salvaging in this forsaken site?

options.text: Research <knowledge></knowledge> the advantages of bloodletting in battle.
Adopt a lost <eventColor>Blood Cultist</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
Studying the Deathless God's tenets turns your <eventColor>Blood Cultist</eventColor> into a <eventColor>Blood Cultist</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
Grind the dead <eventColor>Blood Cultists</eventColor> into fertilizer <food></food> for <eventColor>your city</eventColor>'s farms.

stories.title: Tormenter's Teachings
text: You are initially apprehensive of the screams pouring out of the Crimson Fane below you. But the subsequent laughter stirs your curiosity.

You discover the spectacle within with horror. A Pain Bringer instructs their acolytes in the Teachings of Pain: they pinch, stab, twist, and slice each other open. Blood gushes out from their self-inflicted wounds, and euphoric screams from their throats. The Pain Bringer, embellished with blood spatters, grins with eager delight when the Pain Bringer spots your army and whispers: "More willing flesh?"
The Pain Bringer howls ecstatically and their disciples flock around the Pain Bringer: "Teach these uninvited voyeurs about pain!" How will you respond?

options.text: "There is no pain in death! Strike them down!"
"Think happy thoughts, troops! Take your mind off their torment!"
"You deviants should all be ashamed of yourselves!"

check.header: Attempt to condemn the Pain Bringer's ritualists:
check.success: Your words hit their mark. Your opponents are burdened by shame.
check.failure: The Pain Bringer and their disciples mock your prudish disapproval.

options.text: "This looks like my kind of party! Count me in!"

check.header: <eventColor>Your Hero</eventColor> looks for pleasure in pain too:
check.success: The same exaltation that inspires the ritualists also benefits <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>.
check.failure: To <eventColor>your</eventColor> disappointment, pain still does harm.

options.text: Leave the Pain Bringer and their disciples to their rituals in privacy.

aftermath.title: Tormenter's Teachings: Aftermath
text: You have slain the ritualists that occupied the Crimson Fane. A delighted smile is frozen on the dead the Pain Bringer's lips, to your discomfort.

The dim light of the Crimson Fane reveals that the cave floor is now thoroughly flooded with the blood of the battleslain. Citizens from all over the realm gathered here to worship Pain together. You peruse the elaborate toolkit of the Pain Bringer and find their <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. You wonder if you could ever truly understand what conviction drove these ritualists.
Besides the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>, what would you extract from the Crimson Fane before moving on from this depraved site?

options.text: Experiment with the Pain Bringer's arts <unitHero></unitHero> to increase your durability.
<order></order> Purge all evidence of the Pain Bringer's aberrant rituals from the Crimson Fane.
Drink the blood that was spilled everywhere. <xp></xp> Waste not, want not!
Study the Pain Bringer's lessons to empower your ranged combatants. <knowledge></knowledge>

wonders.name: Crystal Forest
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] per <conduit></conduit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ASTRAL_KEEPER_UNIT]Astral Keeper[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept]Astral Currents[/hyperlink] converge at this location. Rather than forming an ordinary Mana Node, these energies have crystallized into a forest of shimmering trees. Intricate branches and deep, meandering root systems suggest an interconnectedness to much in the universe; [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink], even ages. Time and space have no meaning here.

pool: All Ethereal Units (Except Astral Sea Monsters)
stories.title: The Silver Realm
text: You explore the Crystal Forest of vitreous trees. A tall Knight, clad in silver armor, waits for you.

The Silver Knight draws their sword. "Visitors in the Silver Realm? Has my master finally sent relief?" Howling <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> step forward from the trees. "I see. As I am not yet permitted to venture outside, you are not permitted to venture within." The <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> turn to your troops, snarling. "It appears my master wishes you dead," the Knight declares.
The Silver Knight points their blade at you and lunges forward. "We will fight each other. Until one of us falls."

options.text: Defend against the Silver Knight's attacks.
"You and me until death, Silver Knight!" <mana></mana>
"We've defeated you before. We will defeat you again." <morale></morale>
Replicate the Duelist's Protection that safeguards the Silver Knight.

check.header: Manipulate the Silver Knight's magic to protect yourself against his minions:
check.success: The <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> can barely harm you now.
check.failure: You failed to copy the spell that protects the Silver Knight.

options.text: Retreat from this Silver Realm.

aftermath.title: The Silver Realm: Aftermath
text: The Silver Knight lies at your feet, their blade cracked, but not broken.

The Knight scoffs. "Once," the Silver Knight says, "I was the Wanderer. I sailed the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink] on a quest of my own. Until my master bound me in this form. Now I am doomed to return in another Crystal Forest, in another Realm." Already the Silver Knight's body begins to fade away. "In an everlasting cycle, until my master decides otherwise."
You have an opportunity to break the Silver Knight's curse or seize another boon from the abandoned Crystal Forest.

options.text: Destroy the Silver Knight's blade <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> and end the curse. <goodact></goodact>
Bind one of the ambling <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> <unit></unit> to your will.
Study <knowledge></knowledge> the forest and the Silver Knight's blade before they vanish.
Sever the Knight's hand <evilact></evilact> to display as a trophy. <influence></influence>

pool: All Astral Enchantments Except Tier V
stories.title: Reflections
text: You enter a forest of glowing crystal formations, showing eerie reflections of you and your troops.

As you keep going through the forest, memories overwhelm you. Reflections of yourself fade into visions of the past, present and future, into memories of the good and bad things that you have wrought. Your troops weep and wail, apologizing to their own mirror images. Then, the visions start to take physical form... as creatures appear from the crystal maze.
Your troops scramble and shout in confusion as their reflections come to life and reveal themselves to be <eventColor>Mirror Mimics</eventColor>.

options.text: "Do not despair! To arms!"
Use magic <mana></mana> to fortify your troops against the <eventColor>Mirror Mimics</eventColor>.
Use your mystic knowledge to fortify your troops against the <eventColor>Mirror Mimics</eventColor>.

check.header: Protect your troops from the <eventColor>Mirror Mimic</eventColor>:
check.success: Our army is bolstered by your protection!
check.failure: Your shield wavers as the <eventColor>Mirror Mimics</eventColor> approach.

options.text: "Be not afraid, troops! These mirrors can break like any other!"

check.header: Convince your troops there is nothing to fear
check.success: Your army is bolstered by your fortitude.
check.failure: Your uncertainty cripples you, your troops feel demoralized.

options.text: Retreat before the reflections get a hold of you.

aftermath.title: Reflections: Aftermath
text: As the ambush of the strange reflections dissipates, your troops sigh in relief. The Crystal Forest pulsates with a new energy.

You see a path with many forks up ahead, each one leading to freedom. The crystals shimmer and your troops smile as the new reflections show fond memories from their past. If only for a moment, they find solace and peace within this forest of crystal. You go to take a closer look at the crystals yourself.
The reflections of the Crystal Forest now show fond memories of the past. You gaze into the crystal and remember...

options.text: Remember when you earned your first coin <gold></gold>.
Remember when you first found companionship. <unit></unit>
Remember your first day training with a weapon <item></item>.
Remember the day you cast your first spell <mana></mana>.
Remember the first day you became a <eventColor>Leader</eventColor> <happiness></happiness> among your people.

pool: All Ethereal Units (Except Astral Sea Monsters)
stories.title: Maze of Crystal
text: You discover a thicket of trees made of pure crystal. You find yourself confused by the reflected light around you.

You discover that the further you explore, the more disorienting and twisty this maze becomes. The forest of crystal and light confuses your sense of direction. As you and your army stumble through the maze, you are not sure what is and what is not a path—or merely a reflection.
Blinking in the light, you realize this maze would be the ideal place for an ambush. Something approaches...

options.text: "Ambush or not, retreating shows weakness! To arms!"
Use magic <mana></mana> to use the reflective maze to your advantage.
Use your arcane knowledge to twist the effects of the reflective maze to your advantage.

check.header: Attempt to reflect the magic in the maze:
check.success: The ambushers find their tricks reflected back on them!
check.failure: Your attempt has no effect.

options.text: Retreat the way you came in.

aftermath.title: Maze of Crystal: Aftermath
text: After fending off an ambush, you progress through the dizzying crystal forest. You discover a wandering minstrel.

The minstrel jumps down from their wagon. The <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> is excited to see you. "Oh great <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>, you are a wonder! I am so lost! And the ambushers! Ruffians everywhere! If you could guide me through the mirror maze, I will give you a reward from my wagon." Having mastered the maze, this is no problem for you.
After helping the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>, the minstrel opens their wagon and gestures inside. "Thank you, O <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. Pick your reward."

options.text: Ask the minstrel to perform in <eventColor>your city</eventColor>. <happiness></happiness>
Ask the minstrel for a share of their gold <gold></gold>.
Ask the minstrel to share all the <eventColor>enemy</eventColor> learned <knowledge></knowledge> during their travels.
"Sing about how you were saved by the legendary <influence></influence> <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>."

wonders.name: Hidden Wellspring
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] per <farm></farm> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FarmConcept]Farm[/hyperlink] and <forester></forester> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Friendly [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink] are healed for 30 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] at the end of each strategic <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SPRING_FAIRY]Spring Fairy[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SUMMER_FAIRY]Summer Fairy[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.AUTUMN_FAIRY]Autumn Fairy[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.WINTER_FAIRY]Winter Fairy[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>This lush location is fed by a magical wellspring that flows directly from the fey realm. Mystical waters attract all manner of creatures, unaware that they are potential victims to tricks of the fairy folk. Though what a fairy considers mischief, can be potentially deadly to others! Even the most powerful beings should proceed with a measure of caution.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: The Fairy Court
text: Traversing the wilderness, you and your army happen upon a clearing near a wellspring, where a Fairy Court has assembled.

You have heard about these gatherings in legends. Emissaries of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept]Duathadae[/hyperlink] and other Fey Folk convene in magical places to hold a Fairy Court, where they consult and scheme. Fairy Courts are protected by the veil of lingering mists, but somehow you must have broken through their concealing veil. Around a stone table, Fairies chatter and eat enchanting viands.
Despite the mist, a <eventColor>Spring Fairy</eventColor> spots your warband and shrieks: "Kill the interlopers! Protect the secrets of the Court!"

options.text: Attack the Fairies in the mist.
Magically alter <mana></mana> how mist affects the Fairies.
Conjure magical defenses against the Fey attacks.

check.header: Attempt to protect your army against magical attacks.
check.success: Your army is more resistant against the Fairies' attacks.
check.failure: Your power over magic cannot repel the arcane assaults of the Fey.

options.text: Draw power from the Hidden Wellspring to lower the Fairies' resistance.

check.header: Drain the resistance of the Fey.
check.success: The Fairy Court is more vulnerable against magical attacks.
check.failure: The Fairies giggle at your vain attempts to weaken them.

options.text: Call forth a gale to drive the mists from the Hidden Wellspring.

check.header: Attempt to disperse the concealing mists.
check.success: At your behest, winds carry the protective mists far and away.
check.failure: The mists hold and continue to linger by the Hidden Wellspring.

options.text: Retrace your steps to escape the Court's ire.

aftermath.title: The Fairy Court: Aftermath
text: You stand victorious amid the Fairy Court. "Enough! We yield!" cries a <eventColor>Spring Fairy</eventColor>. "Take a prize from our hoard and go!"

The Fairies use this brief moment of respite to wrap themselves in layers of protective spells. "You must leave," says the <eventColor>Spring Fairy</eventColor>. "But you needn't leave empty-handed." The <eventColor>Spring Fairy</eventColor> waves their little hands and appears to sing a short song. "A blessing I laid upon you: our Gift of Gab! [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AscendedChampLoreConcept]Mortals[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink] will find your words irresistible."
The <eventColor>Spring Fairy</eventColor> pleads: "In exchange for keeping the Fairy Court a secret, go now with one treasure from our gathering."

options.text: Take Fairy food <food></food> from the stone table.
Take the pot of gold <gold></gold> stashed under the table.
Claim a supply of Rainbow Clover.
Choose the power to call Mist.

stories.title: The Frozen Lake
text: After traveling some distance in the hot midday sun, you head toward a wellspring, expecting refreshment...

Despite the heat of the day, the wellspring is frozen solid. Upon its surface sits a family of ducks, frozen in ice. A woman, crowned in glittering icicles, glides closer over the frozen waters. Ice spreads from beneath her icy bare feet. She gingerly caresses the frozen animals, before her head snaps toward you. "Warm blood disturbs my tranquil lake."
She smiles coldly as ice creatures rise from the pristine snow. "Come embrace the White Witch, and be preserved."

options.text: "Time to break the ice! To arms!"
Use magic <mana></mana> to protect yourself from the cold.
Stoke your inner fire to withstand the cold.

check.header: Stay warm through channeling the fire within.
check.success: The cold is no match for your fiery passion!
check.failure: Even your inner fire cannot protect your army from the cold.

options.text: Flee from the icy cold.

aftermath.title: The Frozen Lake: Aftermath
text: As the sun melts the last of the ice, the sound of quacking returns to the spring.

The White Witch fades, her voice a faint cool breeze. "I am but a remnant of the Queen who once ruled here. She raided the warm lands, preserving all life in ice. Frozen markers lead to her treasure vault, but now, they melt." You notice in the last traces of ice there is some kind of map, detailing the hiding place of a lost treasure.
"No time to delay, my secrets melt away." The fast melting symbols are nearly gone.

options.text: Follow directions in the ice depicting a treasure chest. <gold></gold>
Follow directions in the ice depicting a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.
Follow directions in the ice depicting a cold star. <mana></mana>
Ignore the treasure, nurse the wellspring’s natural wildlife <natureboon></natureboon> to life.

stories.title: Bait and Bathe
text: After arduous travels, the bubbling waters of the refreshing Hidden Wellspring seem very inviting to you and your army. The peaceful murmur of the stream is punctuated by playful laughter.

"Don't just stand there!" calls a welcoming, seductive voice, joined by a chorus of laughter. Fair <eventColor>Nymphs</eventColor> are frolicking in the waters of the spring. They beckon invitingly with their bare arms, blocking out the humanoid shapes floating lifelessly under the surface. The <eventColor>Nymphs</eventColor> call out, almost imploring with eager requests. "Join us! Come bathe with us..."
The <eventColor>Nymphs</eventColor> beckon to you to join them in the waters. As your troops approach, their smiles darken. "Come on in! Do not resist."

options.text: "It's a trap! Attack!"
Order your troops to avert their eyes before attacking the <eventColor>Nymphs</eventColor>.
"Do not give in to temptation! Our faith will guide us through this!"

check.header: Invoke holy power to protect your troops from temptation
check.success: No temptation can withstand your unwavering faith.
check.failure: Your commands fall on deaf ears as the <eventColor>Nymphs</eventColor> giggle.

options.text: Back away from these temptresses.

aftermath.title: Bait and Bathe: Aftermath
text: You emerge victorious from the Hidden Wellspring. One final <eventColor>Entwined Thrall</eventColor> approaches, arms raised. "Did I miss all the fun?" She asks playfully.

She continues: "Those hags tricked people only to drown them for sport. They even tried it on me, once, before chasing me away. I'm glad they're..." she pauses to choose her words carefully, "... gone." I'm not like them, I've always wanted to leave the Hidden Wellspring and learn about the world, rather than drown everyone."
The <eventColor>Entwined Thrall</eventColor> smiles. "I don't have much I can offer you except my gratitude, O <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. The Hidden Wellspring is yours."

options.text: "I am only interested in the riches <gold></gold> your treacherous sisters looted."
"I will take the fruits and plants <food></food> you grow here."
"Join me, <eventColor>Entwined Thrall</eventColor>. <unit></unit> Then you can learn all that you desire."

wonders.name: Archon Observatory
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The City gains the ability to convert <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] into <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept]Structure Queue[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LESSER_LIGHT_SPIRIT]Lesser Light Spirit[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LIGHT_SPIRIT]Light Spirit[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: These astonishing structures were raised by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] to gaze upon the stars. Within, oracles read signs of the future written in starlight, forging prophecies to guide the fate of realms. Yet power such as this rarely goes unnoticed... and never uncoveted.

stories.title: Forcing Fate
text: A hooded figure approaches you. Revealing herself as an Oracle—those who read the stars in the Archon Observatory—she proclaims:

"Grand Liberator <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>... It was foretold you would arrive in a time of great need. The Archon Observatory has fallen into the hands of an <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> and their acolytes. They are forcing us to predict their futures, seeking to exploit this knowledge for their own gain. I escaped the temple to bring you this message... but my sisters remain trapped."
The Oracle awaits an answer to their plea. What will you do to those who dare to meddle with destiny?

options.text: "Attack!"
Ask the Oracle for a divination <mana></mana> of the upcoming battle.
Convince <influence></influence> the Oracle that you will need their help to reconquer the Archon Observatory.
Read the stars to predict the enemy's tactics.

check.header: Decipher the prophecies written in the stars.
check.success: You predicted the tactics of the enemy.

options.text: Embrace the shadows to cast a curse upon the acolytes.

check.header: Embrace the shadows to curse your enemies.
check.success: Your enemies are weakened against your attacks.

options.text: Channel your sacred duty to bring judgment upon the wicked.

check.header: Call upon the Archons to empower you.
check.success: The Archons have blessed you with the power to smite your enemies.

options.text: Leave the place for the moment.

aftermath.title: Forcing Fate: Aftermath
text: The last of the acolytes falls—for knowing the future does not grant the power to prevent it.

The Star Seer, high priestess of the Archon Observatory, approaches you and says: "While the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] waged war on distant fronts, these thugs seized their chance and claimed this place. But like the stars in the firmament, our destiny shines brightly once more. Grand Liberator, allow us to shed light on your future, as a token of our gratitude."
What weighs upon your mind? The wars to come? The wealth of the kingdom? Your uncertain fate?

options.text: Ask for a prophecy about war. <unitprod></unitprod>
Ask for a prophecy about prosperity. <food></food>
Ask for a personal prophecy. <xp></xp>

stories.title: A Death Foretold
text: Your footsteps echo through the halls of the Archon Observatory. An Oracle scribbles in a colossal tome.

The Oracle continues writing as the Oracle clamors: "The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] condemned us for recording the deaths foretold in the stars. But there is one name that returns again and again, an impossible blasphemy, a chance of redemption. Your death was decreed by fate long ago, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. Today, I will correct this flaw in destiny"
You have only a few seconds before the guards attack. What will you do?

options.text: "Attack!"
Proclaim <influence></influence> the eternal glory of your immortal reign.
Cast <mana></mana> a spell to keep yourself alive in your last stand.
Draw strength from the Astral Plane to keep yourself alive in your last stand.

check.header: Draw strength from the Astral Plane.
check.success: The energy of the Astral Plane flows into your hero.

options.text: "Not even death dares to bind me."

check.header: Defy death.
check.success: A dark energy embraces your hero.

options.text: "The righteous shall rise once more."

check.header: Show your devotion to Order.
check.success: The light of Order blesses your hero.

options.text: Retreat the troops.

aftermath.title: A Death Foretold: Aftermath
text: The Star Seer—high priestess of the Archon Observatory—kneels before you, defeated. Doubts plague their mind as the Oracle says:

"How can this be? Does fate not want me to succeed? Are the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] heralds of fate, and not its detractors? I have much to reflect upon, <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>. This observatory is now yours—please, allow me to serve, so that I might correct my undoing. I possess knowledge that may be of your interest. Ask wisely."
What will you ask the Star Seer?

options.text: Consult the oracle about your next death.
Consult the oracle about the death of your enemies.
Let the scholars of <eventColor>your city</eventColor> pose their questions.

pool: All Undead Units - No Water Movement
stories.title: Forever in Servitude
text: When you enter the Archon Observatory, everything seems to be working normally—but something uncanny lingers in the air.

The oracles continue their duty of seeking for prophecies in the stars. One of them looks through the telescope. As you approach, the figure turns. Their face has no eyes. A voice forces its way out of their throat, as if the Undead Titan was unused to speaking: "We must fulfill our task... find the prophecy... defend the Archon Observatory..."
These [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RevenantsLoreConcept]Revenants[/hyperlink] are cursed to chase a purpose forever just out of their reach. Will you free them from their eternal torment?

options.text: "We shall destroy these tormented souls!"
Infuse <mana></mana> your units with the power to free the souls.
Produce <structureprod></structureprod> holy water and consecrate this Observatory before attacking.
Teach your units how to free their souls.

check.header: Teach a lesson in magic unraveling.
check.success: Your troops have learned the magic cantrip.

options.text: "Their souls belong to me."

check.header: Claim the souls of the undead.
check.success: The souls of the undead hear your claim.

options.text: "We must embody the light to cast away these shadows!"

check.header: Become the embodiment of light.
check.success: Light shines from within you.

options.text: Leave these wretched souls.

aftermath.title: Forever in Servitude: Aftermath
text: As the last undead is defeated, the souls start leaving their empty carcasses, echoing like a cursed choir.

The voices of the dead chant one final sentence: "The prophecy was never found. The war against Urrath never ended." The columns begin to crack, and the telescopes rust in an instant, suddenly aging. Ancient relics tumble from their shelves, crashing to the floor. As a massive surge of energy is released, mana crystals form throughout the structure.
Your troops gather the crystals on their way out. What will you do before it all decays?

options.text: Save one of the relics. <item></item>
Look through the telescope.
Harvest the souls of the damned. <souls></souls>

wonders.name: Forsaken Temple
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+1 <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] per <researchpost></researchpost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept]Research Post[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SPIRIT_HAWK_UNIT]Spirit Hawk[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Unlocks the Restore action which turns this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SECRET_TEMPLE]Secret Temple[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Intent spells the difference between being abandoned and being forsaken. Any unfortunate [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.SECRET_TEMPLE]Secret Temple[/hyperlink] may become abandoned once they lose purpose or use, to be slowly forgotten to the unrelenting passage of time. Yet Forsaken Temples are sealed off by design. Their overgrown gates serve as a final barrier to unwelcome visitors, bidding them not to disturb the secrets locked inside.

stories.title: Cabal of Casting
text: You find the entrance to a Forsaken Temple. Its doors are sealed. No one has been here for centuries.

Yet inside, lit torches lead the way past cobwebbed frescoes and moss-covered statues to an inner sanctum, where several [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mages[/hyperlink] sit at a round table amid stacks of tomes. The Battle Mages turn to <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> in unison. "Are you the one who shall relieve us?" they utter before rising. Lightning arcs between them. "The one worthy of our secrets?"
The entombed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mages[/hyperlink], weaving a maelstrom of magic, shriek: "Prove your mettle to the Cabal of Casting." How will your react?

options.text: Dive into the magical mayhem to destroy the Cabal.
Ward <mana></mana> your warriors against the afflictions of the Mages' spells.
Demonstrate your command over the arcane.

check.header: Attempt to protect your army against magical attacks:
check.success: The Cabal's spells are less effective against your warriors.
check.failure: The Battle Mages manage to penetrate your magical defenses with their attacks.

options.text: Bask in the maelstrom of magic unleashed by the Mages.

check.header: Divert the summoned chaotic magical energies to empower your army:
check.success: Your army revels in the maelstrom of magic.
check.failure: The onslaught of the magical maelstrom proves too strong to be harnessed.

options.text: Flee the Cabal of Casting and reseal the Forsaken Temple.

aftermath.title: Cabal of Casting: Aftermath
text: When the last of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mages[/hyperlink] falls to your army, they all rise again but do not attack.

"Wardens are we," the souls of the Cabal of Casting declare. "Waiting to confer our secret knowledge on the one foretold to be deserving. You!" At that moment, copious insights and lore wash over you. The Cabal of Casting, its prophecy finally fulfilled, fades out of existence. The Forsaken Temple begins to rumble as its ceiling threatens to come down!
The Forsaken Temple will shortly collapse, permitting you only moments to extract one final secret of the Cabal of Casting.

options.text: Take a cache of binding fragments. <bindingfragments></bindingfragments>
Learn <knowledge></knowledge> the forbidden <evilact></evilact> secrets of the Cabal.
Let not the Battle Mages rest. Claim their souls. <souls></souls>
Drain the magical energies <mana></mana> from the fading Battle Mages.

stories.title: The Forsaken God
text: You discover a Forsaken Temple where a long-forgotten God of <eventColor>(its domain)</eventColor> was once worshiped. Timeless oblivion has effectively killed the God.

A shrine is built inside the Forsaken Temple. You wipe the dust and cobwebs from the shrine to learn that this Temple belonged to the god <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor> long ago. Yet your presence involuntarily feeds the dormant eternal flame of <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor>, which in turn animates his decayed followers. They rise from the dead to worship their deity and protect <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> sanctuary once more.
In the Temple of <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor>, the Forsaken God, nothing truly dies. Not forever. How can you defend yourself against <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> priests?

options.text: Attack the priests of the Forsaken God.
Make an offering <gold></gold> to <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> shrine to receive <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> favor in combat.
Draw power from the revival of the dead.

check.header: Drink in the power of eternal resurrection:
check.success: Your warriors are invigorated by the unlife bestowed upon your opponents.
check.failure: You fail to draw healing energies from resurrections of <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> followers.

options.text: Hallow the Forsaken Temple, laying any revived spirits to rest.

check.header: Suppress the eternal flame of <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor>:
check.success: Revived <eventColor>enemies</eventColor> fall apart not long after they manifest.
check.failure: The eternity of <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor> endures, rendering your piety insufficient.

options.text: Depart from the Forsaken Temple.

aftermath.title: The Forsaken God: Aftermath
text: While the resurrected priests of <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor> have resumed their sleep of death—for now—you may inspect the Forsaken Temple more closely.

The Temple to <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor> contains many age-old relics and riches. This God of <eventColor>(its domain)</eventColor> must have been an important deity to whatever culture of this realm worshiped <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor> so many years ago. Their history is told in the engravings in stone that cover the walls. A holy light then shines down on the golden shrine, and a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> appears.
Your battle rekindled some of <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> divine power. You may claim the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> as your prize. And perhaps even take more.

options.text: Leave the Forsaken Temple untouched <influence></influence> and say a prayer to <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor>. <goodact></goodact>
Siphon whatever remains of the <eventColor>Reward</eventColor> in the Forsaken Temple.
Study the engravings <knowledge></knowledge> scrawled on the Temple walls.
Call forth the souls <souls></souls> that forever linger in the Forsaken Temple.
Melt down <evilact></evilact> the shrine and golden artifacts. <gold></gold>

wonders.name: Lava Prison
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Gain +2 <allegiance></allegiance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.InfluenceConcept]Whispering Stone Strength[/hyperlink] income per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] in your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PrisonConcept]Prison[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Increases the chance of capturing defeated Heroes into your Prison to 100%.</bullet><bullet>Unlocks Free the Primordial Prisoner, a single-use action which grants you a uniquely powerful [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] based on the adventure within.</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Following their ameliorations of the realms in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink], the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giants[/hyperlink] clashed with the gargantuan denizens of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrwildernessLoreConcept]Urwilderness[/hyperlink]. When these primordial behemoths could not be destroyed, the Giants bound them with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon chains[/hyperlink] that drain their energy. Conserved in robust prisons built in pools of lava, they slowly become mortal.

stories.title: Wyrm Wars
text: As your troops march on the daunting Lava Prison, you perceive shallow furrows in the hot mud, leading into its entrance. You enter.

It smells like acid inside. Towering murals depict how stalwart [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giants[/hyperlink] subdued behemoths from the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrwildernessLoreConcept]Urwilderness[/hyperlink]. The murals feature one exceptionally ruthless Primordial Basilisk and its eventual chaining by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink]. You soon learn a terrible truth: this Lava Prison houses that very Primordial Basilisk! What is worse, their Serpent worshipers have broken their chains and now attempt to corrode their Archon collar!
Once the Primordial Basilisk's collar breaks, their full power returns! How will you defend yourself against their kin and allies?

options.text: Charge to cut off their head!
Neutralize the Serpents' caustic pools with simple spells. <mana></mana>
Take <eventColor>your city</eventColor> medicine <food></food> to protect yourself from the Serpents' venom.
Reinforce the Archon collar to delay the Primordial Basilisk's escape

check.header: Bolster the Archon collar that inhibits the Primordial Basilisk's power:
check.success: The collar will endure for a little while longer.
check.failure: You are unable to counter the effect of the caustic venom.

options.text: Induce the Serpents to snap at each other!

check.header: Draw out the lesser Serpents' natural instincts to make them go berserk:
check.success: Some of the Serpents writhe and coil before biting into their kin.
check.failure: You fail to affect the Serpents' minds. They lunge at your troops.

options.text: Retreat from the primordial snake pit.

aftermath.title: Wyrm Wars: Aftermath
text: Knee-deep in venom and acid, your victorious warriors are surrounded by dead Serpents. And one slain Primordial Basilisk.

A bewildered <eventColor>Plague Serpent</eventColor> seeks to slither out discreetly. You pay little attention to the <eventColor>Plague Serpent</eventColor>, instead inspecting the already decomposing corpse of the Basilisk. You yank out one of the Primordial Basilisk's fangs and judge that it passes for a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. Only then do you discover the Basilisk egg. It wobbles and cracks. The Basilisk's offspring may be reared to fight for you!
Soon, the lingering corrosive vapors will melt all within the Lava Prison. What will you take, before it is too late?

options.text: Harvest the fallen Serpents' scales and fangs. <unitprod></unitprod>
Capture the <eventColor>Plague Serpent</eventColor> <unit></unit> before it slithers away.
Raise a new <eventColor>Plague Serpent</eventColor> <unit></unit> from the Primordial Basilisk's corpse.
Learn how to use the Primordial Basilisk's poison <knowledge></knowledge> in battle.

stories.title: Touched By The Flame
text: Amid a vast lava pool, you discover an unusually lofty Lava Prison. A small gate offers a way inside.

Your army enters the vaulted courtyard adorned with clay statues, like immovable prison guards, where you discover a Primordial Pyremoth flying high above you! Their inherent heat melted the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon chain[/hyperlink] that drained their power. Invigorating flames fall from the Primordial Pyremoth's wings, which graze the terracotta warrior statues, kindling life in the sculpted guards!
The animated warriors of clay train their weapons on you, obliged to protect their maker: the thrashing Primordial Pyremoth! Defend yourself!

options.text: Attack! Cut down the moth and its clay protectors!
Nullify <mana></mana> the clay soldiers' ability to resurrect.
Dispatch additional armor <unitprod></unitprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor> to protect your troops.
Crack the soldiers' clay with icy winds.

check.header: Make the warriors' clay brittle so that they take more damage:
check.success: Your attacks will crumble the clay soldiers more easily.
check.failure: The clay from which the warriors are shaped is unaffected.

options.text: Blind Primordial Pyremoth with a bright ball of lightning.

check.header: Conjure a lightning orb to overstimulate the Primordial Pyremoth's vision:
check.success: The Primordial Pyremoth is drawn to the orb's light, blinding it!
check.failure: The Primordial Pyremoth manages to resist the alluring light and attacks.

options.text: Draw from the surrounding lava pools to ignite the clay warriors!

check.header: Test the clay soldiers' love of fire. Engulf them in it:
check.success: The clay warriors are wreathed by immolating flames.
check.failure: Their clay proves to be incombustible. The animated warriors advance.

options.text: Escape the Lava Prison and return another time.

aftermath.title: Touched By The Flame: Aftermath
text: Your army stands victorious over the rubble of the crumbled clay warriors, and the gargantuan husk of the Primordial Pyremoth.

The Moth fell on the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon chain[/hyperlink] that drained life from the Primordial Pyremoth for so many centuries. Unexpectedly, energy arcs from the chain back into the Primordial Pyremoth, which revives once again, as do the two remaining clay statues of a <eventColor>Clay Arbalest</eventColor> and a <eventColor>Clay Arbalest</eventColor>. The revitalized Primordial Pyremoth obeys you. However, for it to leave the Lava Prison, the structure must be destroyed.
Before the Lava Prison collapses into the pool of lava, what do you endeavor to salvage?

options.text: Haul the clay fragments <structureprod></structureprod> of the defeated statues to <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Collect the weapons <unitprod></unitprod> wielded by the clay warriors for <eventColor>Player Capital</eventColor>.
Study the revitalizing effects of the Pyremoth to augment <unitHero></unitHero> yourself.

stories.title: Primordial Clay
text: Your army follows forceful cracks and crunches to a pond of lava, in which an imposing Lava Prison was built.

Inside, you find a Primordial Bloodback broken out of their cell, squatting on the prison floor. Dozens of Lithorine creatures who have made their hive in here, crawl around the Primordial Bloodback. The Primordial Bloodback picks up two <eventColor>Primordial Bloodbacks</eventColor> and smashes them into each other. To your bewilderment, and the Primordial Bloodback's entertainment, the <eventColor>Primordial Bloodbacks</eventColor> reassemble into a Primordial Bloodback!
The escaped Primordial Bloodback notices your warriors. With a snarl, the Primordial Bloodback grabs a nearby Primordial Bloodback and hurls it at you.

options.text: "Defend yourselves! To arms!"
Cast an emergency stun spell <mana></mana> on the <eventColor>Primordial Bloodbacks</eventColor>.
Order miners <structureprod></structureprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor> to hack away at the Lithorine creatures' shells.
Manipulate the movement speed of the Lithorine pests.

check.header: Disperse the Lithorine critters by hastening or slowing them:
check.success: Some of the creatures are slowed, whereas others are hastened.
check.failure: The Lithorine creatures resist your manipulations of their movement.

options.text: "Even the mightiest fall to a thousand strikes made as one, troops!"

check.header: Inspire your army to stand tall against the gargantuan creature.
check.success: Your warriors close rank in unison with determination in their hearts.
