check.failure: Your army is not roused by your hollow words.

options.text: Flee the scene.

aftermath.title: Primordial Clay: Aftermath
text: The last of the Lithorine critters crumbles. The Primordial Bloodback lies at your feet, defeated.

You surmise that the Lithorine infestation has made the prison walls poriferous and brittle, allowing the Primordial Bloodback to escape. The beast finally raises themselves up and cautiously observes your every action. Using gestures, you communicate to the Primordial Bloodback that you will free the Primordial Bloodback from the Lava Prison if the Primordial Bloodback is willing to fight for you. The behemoth ultimately nods.
Lithorine carcasses are shipped to <eventColor>your city</eventColor> to be used as building materials. What else will you confiscate before leaving the Lava Prison's walls?

options.text: Extract precious gems <gold></gold> from the Lithorine carcasses.
Reassemble a Primordial Bloodback from the rubble. <unit></unit>
The limb of a Primordial Bloodback will serve as a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. <item></item>

wonders.name: Lost Tomb
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink], +2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink], and +1 <souls></souls> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulConcept]Soul[/hyperlink] (if obtainable) for each [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CryptConcept]Crypt[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.CORRUPT_SOUL]Corrupt Soul[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>A sinister necropolis crafted by the ancient Shad'rai. Its tunnels and burial chambers seem to expand, almost as if they are alive and seek to accommodate any new inhabitants throughout the ages. This tomb doesn't merely hunger for the bodies of the dead, it yearns to feast upon their very [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SoulsLoreConcept]Souls[/hyperlink].</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: The Sleeper in Shadow
text: You prepare to explore the Lost Tomb when a wide-eyed scribe sprints out: "He slumbers no more! Flee, fools! Flee!"

A chilling wind, as if a monster inhales, pulls you towards the entrance. The ground then trembles, but there is no rumbling. A black fog creeps from the mouth of the Lost Tomb. It conceals a ghastly figure that feels as ancient and evil as it does regal. Your army's resolve dwindles, while insanity claws at your mind.
The kingly Ghoul whispers: "I am the Sleeper in Shadow. Won't you join me inside?" You unwillingly put one step forward.

options.text: Run in to attack the Sleeper in Shadow.
"Troops, keep your mind off whatever sluggish power lingers here!"
Ward <mana></mana> yourself against the icy attacks of the damned and beshadowed.
Kindle the inspiring power of your supporting forces.

check.header: Bolster support actions to encourage your army.
check.success: Your army is rallied by all displays of aid and support.
check.failure: Inspiration falters against the utter darkness of the Lost Tomb.

options.text: "The Natural Order will always prevail against darkness."

check.header: Let your warriors' morale grow strong and boundless.
check.success: Your army is resolved: victory shall be theirs.
check.failure: Your power over [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature[/hyperlink] cannot outgrow the cold and dark.

options.text: "Madness is no match against Chaos."

check.header: Wield [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink] to immunize your army against insanity.
check.success: The minds of your warriors may be weakened, but not driven mad.
check.failure: The madness of the Lost Tomb overshadows your dominion over [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink].

options.text: Snap out of the dreadful enchantment and retreat!

aftermath.title: The Sleeper in Shadow: Aftermath
text: After a fatiguing and nightmarish battle, the Sleeper in Shadow lies crumbled at your feet. The shadow has passed.

You recall ancient legends of the <eventColor>race</eventColor> about an ancient tyrant who was eventually slain and cursed. It was foretold that he would return to challenge any new power that seeks to claim these lands. You realize that your presence in the realm likely awoke the Sleeper in Shadow.
While your warriors search the Lost Tomb for treasure, you ponder how this ordeal changed you for the better.

options.text: Study <knowledge></knowledge> the archaic engravings and murals in the tomb.
Take the Sleeper in Shadow's black crown. <item></item>
The Lost Tomb is bloated with souls. <souls></souls>. Harvest them.
Spread joy <happiness></happiness> in your cities by sealing the tomb undisturbed.

stories.title: Raiders of the Hero Item
text: As you near the gate of the Lost Tomb, the noise of busy pickaxes echoes from its walls.

A band of grave robbers can be spotted working inside. But before you can act, one of the grave robbers yells in horror when a skeletal hand grabs his arm. The grave robbers flee, leaving you and your army to deal with the <eventColor>Bone Horror</eventColor> and other horrors that emerge from the coffins around them.
The grave robbers' greed has awakened the dead! And you find yourself in the middle of it...

options.text: Attack the undead!
Cast a spell <mana></mana> to delay the undead.
Call upon powerful death magics to delay the undead assault.

check.header: Delay the dead:
check.success: The dead remain so for a bit longer.
check.failure: You cannot stop the dead from rising.

options.text: Flee the Lost Tomb.

aftermath.title: Raiders of the Hero Item: Aftermath
text: You have survived the undead onslaught in the Lost Tomb. Now, the tomb is safe to be searched.

With the grave robbers long gone, your army wastes no time and immediately starts to gather any knowledge they can find about the people who were buried here. This tomb belonged to a fallen king, who was buried with his entire court after his assassination.
One of your soldiers points to a few decorated coffins, elevated above the others. Their contents ought to be special...

options.text: Loot the coffin of the king's marshal. <unitprod></unitprod>
Loot the coffin of the king's steward. <gold></gold>
Loot the coffin of the poisoned king himself. <item></item>
I am no grave robber. <goodact></goodact>

stories.title: Eternal Bedchambers
text: It is said only fools would disturb the eternal bedchambers of king <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor>. This, however, does not stop you.

In the center of the tomb you find a large altar with several preserved corpses draped around a decorated king, looking like sleeping lovers even after centuries of being buried. Suddenly the decorated corpse stirs and opens their eyes, their undead lovers following suit. Raspy voices echo through the tomb as they arise and beckon you.
"Welcome, intruders!" <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor> grins. "Have you come to reignite the flames of our passion with your essence?"

options.text: "This debauchery must end! To arms!"
Use your knowledge of the undead to weaken the king and their companions before attacking.

check.header: Weaken the <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor>'s link to the land of the living
check.success: <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor> sighs and moans as their power fades.
check.failure: The undead grin, unaffected by your attempt.

options.text: "You call this passion? Watch me..."

check.header: Attempt to seduce king <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor>
check.success: <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor> can't resist your charms.
check.failure: Even the lich king is disgusted by you.

options.text: Leave.

aftermath.title: Eternal Bedchambers: Aftermath
text: You have defeated the undead king and their lovers. The king rises once more and claps their hands, impressed.

Their raspy voice once again echoes through the Lost Tomb. "You have impressed me, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. Not many are able to do so. You have ignited passions within me I had long forgotten. For that, I wish to thank you."
The lich king bows. "I am yours, o <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>, as is my wealth. I no longer have need of it."

options.text: Take their <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> and leave the undead king.
Recruit <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor> <unit></unit> later.
Recruit <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor>. <unit></unit>
Ask <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor> to share their ancient knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> before leaving the <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor> to rest.
"Rest now forever, <eventColor>Immortal</eventColor>. That is all I can ask." <goodact></goodact>

wonders.name: Magma Forge
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Units cost -25% <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] to recruit.</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FIRE_GIANT]Fire Giant[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>A truly grandiose forge that draws its heat directly from the blazing depths of the world. Legends tell that Titans once utilized these great tools for their grand designs and that the first-born Dwarves may have even emerged from these primordial sites.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: The Wailing Hero Item
text: You enter the Magma Forge to the sound of clinking hammers and anvils. <eventColor>Fire Giants</eventColor> are working the forge.

With every beat of the hammer, you sense a darkness tugging at your resolve. You wish to flee. Abandon hope. Forsake whatever oaths you have taken. The <eventColor>Fire Giants</eventColor>, who have not yet noticed your army, chant. They sing of an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Deity[/hyperlink], portended to return once the forging of the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> is completed. Fear grips your heart.

Eventually, the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> will complete and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Deity[/hyperlink] will enter this realm. Being in its presence dwindles your spirit.

options.text: Attack the devious forgemasters!
Use simple wintry spells <mana></mana> to cool the forge!
Stand proud. <influence></influence> This realm's fate hinges on your resolve <morale></morale> today.
Steel your troops' souls against the spirit-sapping influence.

check.header: Protect your warriors from the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>'s morale sap.
check.success: Your army grows resistant against all morale draining effects.
check.failure: Your zeal cannot overcome the devious drain of the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.

options.text: Leave the Magma Forge. The <eventColor>Fire Giants</eventColor> seem busy after all.

aftermath.title: The Wailing Hero Item: Aftermath
text: You have cleansed the Magma Forge of the forgemasters' cult's presence and denied the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowRealmLoreConcept]Umbral Deity[/hyperlink] its return.

Upon closer inspection, it is clear to you that the <eventColor>Fire Giants</eventColor> have been laboring towards their Deity's return for years. The forging of the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> was to be their final achievement, yet they had already created an army's worth of weapons and armor. This was not merely some unholy worship. This would have become an abominable invasion.
While your troops gather the armaments created in the Magma Forge, you ponder what you should do with the unfinished <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.

options.text: Destroy <goodact></goodact> the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>! <influence></influence>
Take <evilact></evilact> the cursed <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. <item></item>
Reforge <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.

stories.title: Too Hot to Handle
text: You approach the Magma Forge, expecting to see the workers busily smithing. Instead, frowning smiths are standing outside the forge, muttering.

The forgemaster explains that the entire forge suddenly overheated. "No matter how we doused the flames, the heat only grew more intense. It's as though Yaka himself decided to make this place his throne!" The smiths behind him nod in agreement. "I swear, the flames have come alive!" one of them adds, soot covering his face.
The smiths look to you and your troops; hoping a <eventColor>Leader</eventColor> like you can help them. "How do you quench an unquenchable fire?"

options.text: "This fire shall be quenched with blood! To arms!"
Order engineers of <eventColor>your city</eventColor> <structureprod></structureprod> to open cooling vents within the Magma Forge before entering.
Use your knowledge of earth and forges to open the cooling vents beneath the Magma Forge yourself.

check.header: Attempt to open the vents in the forge yourself
check.success: The forge hisses as cooling air meets fire.
check.failure: Nothing happens.

options.text: Retreat from the volatile forge.

aftermath.title: Too Hot To Handle: Aftermath
text: The forge flames flicker and glow, no longer raging out of control. The forgemaster grins from ear to ear.

"Your clever resourcefulness is rare, O <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. I don't suppose you want a job working here with us?" Before you can respond, the forgemaster bursts into an explosive laugh. "No offense meant, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. I am sure your ambitions are far bigger than the simple work we do here. Still…"
The forgemaster nods. "We are indebted to you, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>, Godir of the Magma Forge. Name your prize."

options.text: "I require a new armor." <item></item>
"Forge me a new weapon." <item></item>
"Your debt will be paid in gold <gold></gold>."
"Your good word and hard work for this realm is payment enough, forgemaster." <goodact></goodact>

stories.title: Giants and Debris
text: A grizzled blacksmith stands between you and an ancient forge. "Forge's closed." The Fire Giant sighs, defeated.

"I think our work disturbed a Fire Giant and their minions," the blacksmith laments. "They are on a rampage, tearing the forge apart... We barely made it out alive. The entire structure is collapsing..." the blacksmith wipes their sweaty forehead, tears welling up in their eyes. "Our entire livelihood, gone."
You peer past the blacksmith, toward the collapsing Magma Forge. A rumbling and roaring can be heard from within.

options.text: "I will save the Magma Forge from collapse. To arms!"
Before entering, ask the blacksmiths <gold></gold> to enhance your army.
Before entering, use your structural knowledge to predict any future collapse.

check.header: Attempt to predict where the next collapse will take place in combat.
check.success: The structure and its integrity are no secret to you.
check.failure: Your estimations collapse, much like the Magma Forge.

options.text: Leave the Magma Forge.

aftermath.title: Giants and Debris: Aftermath
text: With the Magma Forge saved, the blacksmith happily returns to you, bowing deeply.

The smiths of the forge immediately start to clear out the debris. "We thank you, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>." The blacksmith harrumphs as the Fire Giant lifts up a big chunk of debris, laughing as the Fire Giant reveals a locked chest. "There it is! Our lockbox made it through!" The Fire Giant opens it to reveal many masterfully crafted objects.
"We will need some time to rebuild the Magma Forge, but I can offer you one of our masterworks as a token of our gratitude."

options.text: Take the <eventColor>Armor</eventColor>. <item></item>
Take the <eventColor>weapon</eventColor>. <item></item>
Take the <eventColor>Trinket</eventColor>. <item></item>
"Since you are so grateful, I will take all three objects." <item></item> <evilact></evilact>
"I need no reward for helping you." <goodact></goodact>

wonders.name: Secret Temple
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] per <researchpost></researchpost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchPostConcept]Research Post[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BLESSED_SOUL]Blessed Soul[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>This hidden temple complex is forgotten by time. Herein did the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] once worship the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept]Allfather[/hyperlink]. However, the light that aided the masses in connecting with the divine has long since been extinguished. The site's once grand halls now attract cultists and sinister entities seeking to awaken and twist its power.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: Order Of The Glutton
text: You approach the Secret Temple built by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] long ago, and are greeted by chanting and a most foul odor.

Peeking inside, you witness the mass of a cult, who have built half a dozen piles of bone and flesh. their center, a <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> feeds a gluttonous <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> rotting carcasses to empower it. The cultists chant about the coming of The World Devourer, augured to consume the realm. Once the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> is sufficiently fed, the cultists will unleash it.
The Order of the Glutton will soon set the devouring <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> loose on the world. Their mad scheme should be stopped.

options.text: "Today your cult ends, you madmen!"
Magically hasten <mana></mana> your fighters to quickly strike at the flesh piles.
Poison the piles of bone and flesh that the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> will devour.

check.header: Attempt to taint the food intended for the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor>.
check.success: The flesh piles will do the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> more harm than good.
check.failure: Your subtle contaminations do not even nauseate the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor>.

options.text: "By the legacy of the Archons, I rebuke and denounce you!"

check.header: Condemn all enemies of the Archons in the Secret Temple.
check.success: Your army fights this battle with justice and honor on your side.
check.failure: The <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> and cultists are not rebuked and attack.

options.text: Beguile the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> to view your army as most unappetizing.

check.header: Hex your troops so that the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> won't devour them.
check.success: The <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> claws at your warriors, too disgusted to eat them.
check.failure: The <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> wets its lips as it prepares for the attack and a meal.

options.text: Flee the Secret Temple and the cult, for now.

aftermath.title: Order Of The Glutton: Aftermath
text: You have thwarted the scheme of the Order of the Glutton and slain the gorging <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor>.

While inspecting the Secret Temple, another <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> jumps out from a hidden alcove, attempting to escape. With the last corruptor leaving the Temple, the grace of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] that once ennobled this Secret Temple is restored, and you feel their arcane blessing surge through your body.
Yet the Secret Temple is still befouled by filth and decay. How will you deal with the cult's mess?

options.text: Strip the Secret Temple of its last remaining treasures. <gold></gold>
Clean up the Secret Temple to restore some of its former glory. <influence></influence>
Deliver the meat <food></food> intended for the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> to <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Run after the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor> <unit></unit> and enlist the <eventColor>Karagh</eventColor>.

stories.title: A New Creed
text: You approach the Secret Temple. Fading, unreadable words are emblazoned across the first footstone.

You see a crumbling statue at the far end of the temple, depicting an ancient unknown [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink]. Before you can progress further, a <eventColor>Sun Priest</eventColor> appears, followed by a booming voice. "You walk in divine halls of a Godir long lost. Are you, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>, to be its new patron? Prove you are worthy through this trial."
"Confess, and prove you are worthy of our devotion." Your army looks at you, curious how you will respond.

options.text: "I have nothing to confess to you. Challenge me!"
Pay penance <gold></gold> and confess your sins before facing the <eventColor>Sun Priest</eventColor>.
"You want to hear about my sins? Where should I start?"

check.header: Share your many sins in excruciating detail.
check.success: Your stories leave a lasting impression.
check.failure: Your stories only lead to more condemnation.

options.text: Confess your sins with vigor and gravitas.

check.header: Confess with vigor to impress everyone in the temple:
check.success: Your confession leaves an impression.
check.failure: Your dramatic act does not impress.

options.text: <goodact></goodact> "None are free of sin, but I aim to be better."
Leave the Secret Temple.

aftermath.title: A New Creed: Aftermath
text: You have withstood the trials of the Secret Temple. The halls fall silent.

As you venture further, a shimmering passes over a massive statue at the far end of the temple. When the light disappears, the statue has changed to show none other but you, <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. The voice booms once more. "You have proven yourself a worthy [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink], O <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. Henceforth this Temple will be dedicated to you and your divine word."
The voice fades, and with it, the original words of the temple. A silence falls... As if the temple waits for a new creed.

options.text: "Perfection through change." <chaosboon></chaosboon>
"Balance through growth." <natureboon></natureboon>
"Stability through law." <orderboon></orderboon>
"Truth through understanding." <astralboon></astralboon>
"Legacy through fortitude." <materiumboon></materiumboon>
"Life through death." <shadowboon></shadowboon>
"Divinity through majesty." <influence></influence>
"Power through greed." <evilact></evilact>
"Unity through sacrifice." <goodact></goodact>

stories.title: Scrolls of Terror
text: You and your retinue approach the grand Secret Temple, decorated with depictions of stern-looking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink].

You hear eerie chanting coming from within and espy a group of hooded figures performing some sort of ritual. Suddenly, a blood-curdling scream echoes through the temple. This group is summoning something... Something big, and otherworldly. Your companions swallow nervously as they look on, awaiting orders.
You wonder if you should allow the summoning ritual to continue, or stop it before it is too late...

options.text: "Stop this ritual NOW! To arms!"
Delay the ritual for as long as possible <mana></mana> and attack.
"Faith will help us in delaying this desecration!"

check.header: Invoke your faith to delay the foul ritual
check.success: The cultists stammer when faced with your light. The ritual will take longer to complete.
check.failure: The cultists laugh at your attempt and their ritual completes even faster.

options.text: Take over the ritual. Whatever is summoned belongs to you.

check.header: Attempt to finish their ritual yourself
check.success: The cultists stammer as you take over their ritual with ease.
check.failure: The cultists laugh at your attempt and their ritual completes even faster.

options.text: Leave.

aftermath.title: Scrolls of Terror: Aftermath
text: With the cultists gone and their ritual undone, the Secret Temple at last falls silent and you are free to investigate.

The cultists were not praising the deities for whom the Secret Temple was built at all. A malicious-looking scroll sits in the center of the ritual circle: an artifact used to summon beings from a world called Obbadoth, bearing illustrations of beings like <eventColor>Fire Wyverns</eventColor>. It seems the cultists were using this scroll to call on this demonic power.
The demonic scroll is silent, and yet incredibly captivating. So much knowledge rests within...

options.text: The knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> contained within this fiendish scroll could certainly be of use to you...
Use the scroll to summon and control a unit <unit></unit> of true evil origin... <evilact></evilact>
Burn the scroll. Cleanse the Secret Temple. <goodact></goodact>

wonders.name: Shrouded Arcanum
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+5 <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldMapCastingPointConcept]World Map Casting Points[/hyperlink]</bullet><bullet>+5 <optactical></optactical> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CombatCastingPointConcept]Combat Casting Points[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: The epitome of the Shrouded Isles; a Wizard Tower steeped in secret and experimental magic, hidden from the prying gaze of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink]. They were created as a subterfuge to elude the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Circle of Deogai[/hyperlink], established by those very divine guardians, who, after the disaster of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TheFracturingLoreConcept]the Fracturing[/hyperlink], sought to limit the power and danger of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard Kings[/hyperlink].

stories.title: Yaka's Bastards
text: A group of zealots guards the Arcanum. But their appearance is... peculiar, Tigran and human-like features fight to form a cohesive face.

A Primal Sabertooth steps out from the group and yowls to their peers in a bizarre feline pitch:
" Nyaaa~, the day has finally come! At last, we may atone for our fur-gotten failure and our weaknesses. Today, we will claw back the favor of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.YakaLoreConcept]Yaka[/hyperlink] and earn our fur-giveness, leaving this inbred transfurmation behind.
The Primal Sabertooth turns to you and yaps: "What is left of our honor resides in the purr-tection of this place. We will not let you have it, nyaaa~."

options.text: Attack the furred race.
Incite them <influence></influence> to revolt against Yaka. <unit></unit>
Tap into Yaka's power to fight them.

check.header: Attempt to draw the energy pulsating from the Arcanum:
check.success: You embody the power of Yaka with fire on your hands, daunting the defenders.

options.text: Leave the Arcanum for now.
"Meow, meow meow meow meow." <popualtion></popualtion>
They still have plenty to pay for, ask them for tribute. <gold></gold>

aftermath.title: Yaka's Bastards: Aftermath
text: The last of the defenders falls, humiliated once more. Their feline voice chirps:

"Another dishonor falls upon our name, nyaaa~. The Azrac will never make up for our failures in the Ashen Steppe. We shall endure this purr-gatory forever, trapped in a failed ascension to glory." It seems Yaka used the remaining Azrac in his first attempt to create the Tigrans and abandoned the unsuccessful result.
What will you do with the remnants of this race?

options.text: Receive <population></population> the former Azrac under your empire.
Ask them for a tribute <gold></gold> in exchange of their life.
Free the world of the remnants of the Azracs. <xp></xp> <evilact></evilact>

stories.title: Zaethyl's Sanctuary
text: You pass lush forests and a clear spring to discover Shrouded Arcanum. You note its harmony with the surrounding nature.

You lead your army deep into the secluded paradise; verdant, vibrant, and fertile. Statues and murals detail the history of this conservatory. Originally barren and scarred, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZaethylLoreConcept]Zaethyl Silverleaf[/hyperlink] healed the wastelands by weaving [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NatureConcept]Nature[/hyperlink]. A sanctuary grown for benevolent wildlife and her First Elves who, after chronicling this history, departed. Only <eventColor>Entwined Thralls</eventColor> remain, tasked with the Sanctuary's defense.
Your army's presence alarms the Entwined guardians. Their defensive instincts unfold as you must decide how to deal with them.

options.text: Fell these arborescent defenders!
Before attacking, have lumberers <structureprod></structureprod> from <eventColor>your city</eventColor> clear the battlefield of vegetation.
Tap into Zaethyl Silverleaf's power. Root the Entwined guardians.

check.header: Encourage the Entwined warriors' feet to take root:
check.success: The Entwined creatures are slowed down by the firm planting of their feet.
check.failure: The roots are willing, but the Entwined march on regardless.

options.text: Make like a tree and leave.
Take one of the <eventColor>Entwined Thralls</eventColor> <unit></unit> with you.
Pick some of the fruit for <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.

aftermath.title: Zaethyl's Sanctuary: Aftermath
text: Peace has returned to Zaethyl's Sanctuary. Your warriors are free to roam the hidden forest of the Elf Queen.

This is a wild but fertile land. Plump berries and juicy fruits hang from long branches of old trees. When you inspect a statue of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ZaethylLoreConcept]Zaethyl Silverleaf[/hyperlink], a beam of light illuminates you both. Her marble effigy appears to smile in your presence. Warmth engulfs you, and you become aware of a hidden scroll revealing Zaethyl's secrets.
Despite the comfort of Shrouded Arcanum, your army's respite will soon pass. What bounty shall they take with them?

options.text: Harvest the ripe fruits <food></food> that hang from the trees and bushes.
Pick up a gnarled branch <item></item> to wield as a weapon.
Plant trees from Shrouded Arcanum in all of your cities. <natureboon></natureboon>
Cut down the trees of Zaethyl's Sanctuary to use as lumber. <structureprod></structureprod>

stories.title: Belbedor's Folly
text: A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept]Duathadae[/hyperlink] warband has breached this infernal realm and penetrated Shrouded Arcanum. You find them inside, encircling a bewildered Feylor.

They triumphantly jeer at the creature until one of them notices you. "Ah, Belbedor's servants. You're too late. Behold our mockery of your Master's creation! The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept]Duatha[/hyperlink] Demon." The Feylor, torn between their fiendish and Fey natures, inspects their own form. "I feel...," the monster growls. "Glittery? Watch me dance!" The creature belches frosted lightning. "Pretty lights!" roars the Feylor.
Some [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept]Duathadae[/hyperlink] cheerfully draw weapons while others summon concealing mists. "Come, brothers and sisters. These trespassers will still our hunger."

options.text: Show the Duathadae your martial prowess.
Before you charge in, dispel <mana></mana> the summoned mists.
Tap into Belbedor's power and flay the Feylor's mind with Chaos.

check.header: Attempt to relax the Duathadae's hold over the Feylor:
check.success: The Feylor writhes in mental agony and lashes out against their masters.
check.failure: The Feylor shrugs off your influence. It is fully under control of the Duathadae.

options.text: Retreat from Shrouded Arcanum.

aftermath.title: Belbedor's Folly: Aftermath
text: The last of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept]Duathadae[/hyperlink] falls, still clenching her <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> as she attempts to chortle through blood and pain.

"Fools. Fools like your Master, Belbedor the Haughty, who believed he could conquer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept]Duatha[/hyperlink]. Our dungeon is now his dwelling, until my kin devours him." She coughs up blood. "You felled the abomination, but your Master's spell is branded by us. It only produces <eventColor>Feylors</eventColor>." She wheezes: "The last laugh... is ours," then dies with a smile on her lips.
You recover the scrolls that summon <eventColor>Feylors</eventColor>: Duatha Demon abominations. What else will you claim from this infernal place?

options.text: Take the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> held by the Duathadae Captain.
Loot <gold></gold> the Fey for relics and jewelery.
Filter magical power <mana></mana> from the dissipating mists.
Wield the Arcanum's Obbadothan energies to summon <unit></unit> an <eventColor>Entwined Scourge</eventColor>.

stories.title: Frikka's Deception
text: You arrive at the structure, surrounded by shards of glass floating everywhere—like a labyrinth of broken mirrors.

You catch a strange movement out of the corner of your eye. When you turn, your own reflection is looking at you through one of the shattered fragments. An unsettling feeling washes over you, as if something else was staring back from the other side of the mirror. And then... it is. Your reflection begins to move on its own, advancing toward you with menace.
Suddenly, your troops find themselves surrounded by reflections of themselves. And somewhere, your distorted double—now gone—lets out a laugh.

options.text: Attack your dopplegangers.
Empower yourself, you are better than your twisted self.
Tap into Frikka's power.

check.header: Attempt to draw the energy pulsating from the Arcanum:
check.success: You trick one of the reflections to turn into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PIGLET]Piglet[/hyperlink].
check.failure: Your connection with Frikka's power did not succeed.

options.text: Leave the Arcanum for now.
Absorb the mirage <mana></mana>, revealing the true form of the region.
Keep the place hidden, secrets are your power. <influence></influence>

aftermath.title: Frikka's Deception: Aftermath
text: The last of the dopplegangers falls, transforming into a mimic. As its reflection shatters, so too does that of the entire region.

With the mirage broken, you can now see the Secret Scroll of Frikka in the Arcanum. Alongside it lie infiltration plans naming nearly every Godir you know. Making you wonder how many places Frikka has agents in. The voice of one of the dying creatures startles you: "What a shame... You would have made a fine addition to the puppet show."
The energy of the mirage now lies exposed. What will you do with it?

options.text: Redirect a piece to tame the surviving mimic.
Absorb it <mana></mana>, revealing the true form of the region.
Conceal it, keep the secret for yourself. <influence></influence>

stories.title: Bhajif's Regret
text: A great city rises around the Arcanum, its buildings growing ever more archaic the closer they stand to the magical structure.

The voice of a Spellbreaker cries out at your arrival: "For the Astral Sea! Arcanist, send a projection to the city, the Erranstar's Gate has opened once more at last." After a pause, the Spellbreaker turns to your troops: "The way is shut, traveler. Those Who Remained Behind keep it. Leave these lands, for they are tainted by an energy that could destroy magic itself."
Crackling fissures spread from the Arcanum, emitting an unsettling aura. It feels like a precursor to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FractureLoreConcept]devouring energy[/hyperlink].

options.text: Attack the guardians.
Protect <mana></mana> your units against their magic.
Tap into Bhajif's power.

check.header: Attempt to draw the energy pulsating from the Arcanum:
check.success: A brief flare of Unmaker magic empowers your troops.
check.failure: Your connection with Bhajif's power did not succeed.

options.text: Leave the Arcanum for now.
Honor the friends who stayed behind. <morale></morale>
Read your old research notes. <knowledge></knowledge>
Destroy all notes of your discoveries with the Unmakers. <goodact></goodact>

aftermath.title: Bhajif's Regret: Aftermath
text: Beyond the fallen guards, you find dozens of journals documenting the magical experiments of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.BhajifLoreConcept]Bhajif Erranstar[/hyperlink].

It seems that many of the most significant discoveries of the Unmakers were made by him. But his final experiment unleashed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FractureLoreConcept]devouring energy[/hyperlink]. Realizing the danger, Bhajif departed to warn other Unmakers. The dying voice of one of the guardians startles you: "If you see the Erranstar, tell him that Those Who Remained Behind kept their vow till their end. Even after generations."
What will you do with the remnants of this race?

options.text: Honor the vow of the guardians, and leave the place untouched. <goodact></goodact>
Take it for yourself. <item></item>
Reverse-engineer it. <knowledge></knowledge>

pool: All Nature Enchantments Except Tier V
stories.title: Nimue's Obsession
text: As you approach the Arcanum, you find a large conch shell imbued with magic. When you touch it, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NimueLoreConcept]a feminine voice, deep as the sea[/hyperlink], emanates from it:

"The <eventColor>Nimus</eventColor> were a success, a symbiosis of life and magic. But I need something that reaches the land, spreading reverence for their goddess across the world..." Before you realize, a colony of penguins has gathered around the Arcanum. They start squawking as a vast shadow moves beneath the water. Suddenly, a Direcaster bursts from the sea in a mighty leap.
As the beast lands beside the Arcanum, the <eventColor>Dire Penguins</eventColor> move in perfect synchrony, forming ranks to protect their queen.

options.text: Attack the penguins.
Summon roots to entangle <mana></mana> their feet.
Tap into Nimue's power to call nature to aid you.

check.header: Attempt to draw the energy pulsating from the Arcanum:
check.success: Summon a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FLORAL_STINGER]Floral Stinger[/hyperlink] on your side during the battle.
check.failure: Nature did not hear your call.

options.text: Leave the Arcanum for now.
Gift it to the Direcaster so that one of their eggs hatches. <unit></unit>
Make the natural resources of the region bloom. <food></food>

aftermath.title: Nimue's Obsession: Aftermath
text: When the clash of battle has faded, you can hear the conch once more:

"...There is something wicked about that filthy creature. How dare those short-legged birds worship her instead of me! I would drown them all if they were not amphibious. I will let them rot here, trapped, until they have learned their lesson. I need to evolve smarter creatures. I should have known better than to use a bird that cannot even fly."
The region around the Arcanum is a reef blooming with energy. What will you do with it?

options.text: Create a symbiosis with Nimue's creation.
Make the penguin eggs <unit></unit> hatch with the energy.
Overload the oysters to produce magic imbued pearls. <food></food> <mana></mana>

stories.title: Noctus' Darkest Night
text: The Arcanum appears to have once been a council chamber, its seats occupied by corpses. An illusion of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NoctusLoreConcept]Noctus[/hyperlink], walks beside them.

Between massive <eventColor>Necrotic Spires</eventColor>, the echo from the past speaks to the lifeless crowd: "Today, my council, I have stepped into the darkest night. Chancellor Rezak, I know you will have poisoned my cup during the celebration, bringing the plot you all devised to its conclusion. And so, I died as a martyr to our people..." His speech gets lost as he walks further into the room.
As you draw closer, the corpses of guards and chancellors begin to rise, placing themselves between your troops and the Arcanum.

options.text: Attack the undead.
Ready the weapons <unitprod></unitprod> to destroy the Necrotic Spires.
Tap into Noctus' power to summon your own undead.

check.header: Attempt to draw the energy pulsating from the Arcanum:
check.success: Those who never rest answer your call.
check.failure: You could not withstand the gaze of the abyss.

options.text: Leave the Arcanum for now.
Siphon the souls <souls></souls> of the damned.
Collect the magic energy <mana></mana> that lingers.

aftermath.title: Noctus' Darkest Night: Aftermath
text: After defeating those who never rest, the voice of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NoctusLoreConcept]High Chancellor[/hyperlink] can be heard once more:

"By the time you behold this illusion, it will already be too late. For death can only be paid with life—and yours shall serve as the price for its knowledge and my rebirth. I would like to offer you comfort, tell you that you may rest in peace... but you made a vow, and you shall serve your people in life and in death."
The ritual that brought Noctus back still grips this chamber. The veil between life and death is thin. You could make use of it.

options.text: Study <knowledge></knowledge> the Necrotic Spire.
Siphon the souls <souls></souls> of the damned.
Sacrifice your own troops for knowledge <knowledge></knowledge> and power <xp></xp>.
Collect the magic energy <mana></mana> that lingers.

pool: All Materium Except Tier V Enchantments
stories.title: Ydgaard's Greed
text: After passing many [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MineConcept]<mine></mine> Mines[/hyperlink] in this valley of gold, you lead your army into Shrouded Arcanum.

You enter an impressive vaulted hall. An immaculate gold statue of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.YdgaardLoreConcept]Ydgaard Worldbender[/hyperlink] is placed at the center. The statue is encircled by stone tables on which lifelike statues of gold rest. You recognize golems, but also spot [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Heroes[/hyperlink]. When you approach Ydgaard's statue, the Void Stone that replaced his heart quivers as the surrounding gold statues stir.
Ydgaard's gilded wardens rise and quietly form ranks to defend the Shrouded Arcanum against invaders. Are you ready for battle?

options.text: Attack the golden host of Ydgaard Worldbender.
Cast flaming spells <mana></mana> to soften the golden casings of the Shrouded Arcanum's defenders.
Tap into Ydgaard's power to harness the potency of gold.

check.header: Attempt to replicate the gilding magic of Ydgaard Worldbender:
check.success: Your warriors have a small chance to turn their enemies into gold.
check.failure: Ydgaard's power refuses to bend to your will.

options.text: Abandon this gold-stained tomb.
Collect lost notes <knowledge></knowledge> of older experiments you conducted here.
Bring some of the gold <gold></gold> kept in this vault.

aftermath.title: Ydgaard's Greed: Aftermath
text: The golden defenders were no match for your army's might. You may now explore Ydgaard's hall.

Shrouded Arcanum served as treasury and laboratory. Here, [hyperlink,GLOBAL.YdgaardLoreConcept]Ydgaard Worldbender[/hyperlink] experimented on his subjects, some of whom you defeated just now. Your eye is drawn to Ydgaard's pure gold statue. The Void Stone that replaced Ydgaard's heart pulsates with energy. When your hand touches the relic, it transmutes into a sheet of gold leaf on which Ydgaard etched his most elaborate spell.
Ydgaard's greed drove him to exchange his followers' gentleness for wealth. Will his obsession corrupt you in a similar way?

options.text: Melt down Ydgaard's statue. <gold></gold>
Study <knowledge></knowledge> Ydgaard's laboratory equipment.
Use Ydgaard's gold to decorate your throne room. <influence></influence>
Leave Shrouded Arcanum without taking anything. <goodact></goodact>

stories.title: Artica's Heart
text: You march into Shrouded Arcanum to find endless halls of gleaming ice. The slow beating of a drum beckons to you.

All corridors lead to the central hall of the Ice Palace. A circle of ice sculptures of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArticaLoreConcept]Artica[/hyperlink] all point to their middle. There, on a pedestal of frost, lies a frozen heart; beating still, however slowly. The Heart of Artica. Your presence has slightly raised the temperature, yet this was enough to stir Artica's minions, encased in ice.
As your army struggles to stay warm, frozen defenders rise from their icy tombs to defend their Queen's inner sanctum.

options.text: Shatter the icy defenders.
Cast fiery spells <mana></mana> to keep your army warm during the battle.
Tap into Artica's power to shield your warriors.

check.header: Attempt to protect your army from wintry attacks:
check.success: Your troops barely feel the ice-tipped blades of Artica's defenders.
check.failure: You can muster no protection against the permafrost.

options.text: Retreat from the Ice Palace.
Form a <eventColor>Frost Giant</eventColor>, your servant of snow, <unit></unit> to bolster your army.
Collect the frozen mana crystals <mana></mana> that deposited among the hoarfrost.

aftermath.title: Artica's Heart: Aftermath
text: The last frozen defender shatters on the icy floor. You are free to inspect the Heart of Artica.

The heat of battle thawed the Shrouded Arcanum, revealing frescoes that depict the primordial struggle of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArticaLoreConcept]Artica[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept]Karissa[/hyperlink]: caught betwixt sororal battle and balance since time immemorial. The Heart of Artica was created as Karissa's ultimate foil, should her fury burn too fierce. You shatter it to produce a rimy scroll—and a bottled flame that warmed the Heart's core.
You read the frozen scroll to unlock Artica's power. Are there other boons to collect from Shrouded Arcanum?

options.text: Collect the Heart's remains <bindingfragments></bindingfragments> before wintry winds disperse it.
Reassemble the <eventColor>Frost Giant</eventColor> that fell in battle.
Extract ancient lore <knowledge></knowledge> that was frozen in time.
Release the souls <souls></souls> trapped in the ice.

pool: All Astral Enchantments Except Tier V
stories.title: Cinren's Carousal
text: Intoxicating vapors draw you towards Shrouded Arcanum, making you feel light-headed. Spirited voices call your warriors in.

Inside, your army discovers an eternal festival of hedonism and debauchery in honor of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CinrenLoreConcept]Cinren Toliath[/hyperlink]. His followers cheer and sing, filling up goblets with a potent liquid, red as blood, spewed from silver fountains. They raise their glass when they notice you and amicably offer your warriors their drinks. Before you can intervene, one of them downs the fluid.
Merriment immediately washes away from the warrior's face. The mood shifts abruptly. You disturbed the <eventColor>race</eventColor>'s sacred festivities. They draw weapons.

options.text: Attack the celebrators of Cinren.
Cast an amnesia spell <mana></mana> on the affected warrior.
Tap into Cinren Toliath's power and free your mind of sorrows.

check.header: Attempt to boost the morale of your army:
check.success: The thought of battle brings your warriors joy.
check.failure: Your troops' minds are too clouded to become aroused.

options.text: Leave this party early. You've overstayed your welcome.
Invite one of the guests, a <eventColor>Nymph</eventColor>, to join you. <unit></unit>
Allow the celebrations <morale></morale> of Shrouded Arcanum to spread to your armies.

aftermath.title: Cinren's Carousal: Aftermath
text: Your army has snuffed out the light of Cinren's party. His disciples lie dead on the floor of Shrouded Arcanum.

Now that the festival has ended, you explore Shrouded Arcanum with clear mind. This debauched festival has persisted for centuries, enabling Cinren's followers to accumulate excessive reservoirs of lecherous potency. You then notice a lone, empty chair, labeled "[hyperlink,GLOBAL.CinrenLoreConcept]Cinren Toliath[/hyperlink]." A chalice is placed on the chair. The urge to drink it becomes irrepressible. You are compelled to drink.
The chalice produces a scroll detailing Cinren's jubilant power over the unwilling mind. What other rewards might the Shrouded Arcanum yield?

options.text: Teach your <eventColor>race</eventColor> Cinren's tenets <knowledge></knowledge> for revelry.
Have <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> study <unitHero></unitHero> the encouraging power of hedonism.
Have the clarity of the chalice protect the mind of your warriors.
Distribute the flowing intoxicating liquid, now powerless, in your cities. <chaosboon></chaosboon>
Distribute the flowing intoxicating liquid, now powerless, in your cities. <natureboon></natureboon>
Distribute the flowing intoxicating liquid, now powerless, in your cities. <astralboon></astralboon>
Distribute the flowing intoxicating liquid, now powerless, in your cities. <shadowboon></shadowboon>

stories.title: Karissa's Rekindling
text: Making your way through the charred and lava-flooded domain, you taste ash in the air as you approach Shrouded Arcanum.

Your troops swelter as they step into a courtyard dotted with burnt-out pyres, traces of a harrowing history. Echoing screams of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept]Karissa[/hyperlink] reverberate within her secret sanctuary. You realize, this is where Karissa was kindled and reborn anew, many times over. Her screams take form as <eventColor>Immolated Souls</eventColor>, flaming defenders of her sanctum, sparked by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink] yet fueled by Karissa's fury.
The <eventColor>Immolated Souls</eventColor> gaze at your warriors, who sense an uncomfortable heat swell within them. Can you extinguish this fiery threat?

options.text: Snuff out the flames of the defenders. Charge!
Magically cool <mana></mana> your warriors before engaging the fiery foes.
Tap into Karissa's power. Ignite your army's fervor.

check.header: Let Karissa's fiery passion overtake your warriors:
check.success: Karissa's vigorous power courses through your troops' veins, strengthening them.
check.failure: Karissa's passion fails to kindle your warriors' souls.

options.text: This is likely too hot for your troops to handle. Get out.
Recover a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> from the pyre ashes to take with you.
Use your fury to kindle the warrior spirits <morale></morale> of your <eventColor>race</eventColor>.

aftermath.title: Karissa's Rekindling: Aftermath
text: The burning flames of her defenders quenched, the sanctum of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KarissaLoreConcept]Karissa[/hyperlink] is now safe for you to explore.

Karissa's screams resound again. They are released from the central pyre. You feel your temperature rising as you steps closer. Laying your hand on the charred wood, you sense the volatile magic sealed within. Dancing flames unexpectedly erupt from the pyre, engulfing you and revealing a charred scroll. When you unfurl it, a single frozen tear falls out and shatters.
Karissa's primordial spell is now yours. What other boon will you take from Shrouded Arcanum before moving on?

options.text: Feed any lingering embers to the forges <unitprod></unitprod> in <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Rouse <xp></xp> <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> in the heat of Shrouded Arcanum.
Spread the revels of Karissa's heat <chaosboon></chaosboon> to all of your cities.
Train your troops to endure the sizzling heat inside Shrouded Arcanum.

wonders.name: Fractured Tower
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+5 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchConcept]Research[/hyperlink] per <conduit></conduit> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ConduitConcept]Conduit[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FRACTURED_EVOKER]Fractured Evoker[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Fragments of an ancient Wizard Tower that once belonged to one of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnmakersLoreConcept]Unmakers[/hyperlink]. These structures were the epicenter of experiments that tampered with the very essence of magic. Now their foundations barely clutch onto reality, consumed and contaminated by the energies that awakened long ago within its walls.

stories.title: Forlorn Puppeteer
text: You enter the Fractured Tower with healthy trepidation. A voice, eerily devoid of emotion, rings out: "Help us. You must help us."

A Lost Wizard looks straight at you, their expression blank. Other mages and warriors are huddled together in the Tower's shadowy hall. "Yes. Come closer. You must help us," speaks a Lost Wizard, but you again detect no spirit in their voice. More hollow-eyed people shamble towards the center of the hall. A hoarse hiss from the darkest shadows then draws your attention.
From the shadows, an <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> puppeteers the Lost Wizard and the other victims, who draw their weapons silently to attack you.

options.text: Attack the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> and their unwilling flock.
Break <mana></mana> the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s hold over the Lost Wizard.
Let your stupefying glory <influence></influence> shield your warrior from the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s dominance.
"Our faith is stronger than this cretin's dark curse."

check.header: Attempt to protect Faithful warriors from domination effects.
check.success: Your zeal successfully shields your army's sanity.
check.failure: The power of the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> proves greater than your faith.

options.text: Convert one of the mind controlled warriors to your side.

check.header: Seize control of one of the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s victim's broken mind:
check.success: One of the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s slaves obeys your commands during battle.
check.failure: The <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s hold over their minions is too fierce to break.

options.text: Leave the Fractured Tower before your army falls to the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s spell.

aftermath.title: Forlorn Puppeteer: Aftermath
text: You felled the puppeteering <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> and their victims.

Released from the foul creature's control, surviving <eventColor>Lost Wizards</eventColor> vacantly shamble throughout the Fractured Tower. You ignore them. Instead, you look to investigate how this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] gained mind-controlling abilities. As you study the corpse, a third eye suddenly pops open in the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s forehead. You wonder if this particular <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> had been enthralled by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowDemonsLoreConcept]Umbral Demons[/hyperlink] before arriving in this realm.
You carve out the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s third eye and spend some time studying it. What will you focus on?

options.text: Restore the sanity of the ambling <eventColor>Lost Wizards</eventColor> <unit></unit> and recruit them.
Assimilate the Lost Wizard's mutation <evilact></evilact> to gain <unitHero></unitHero> domination powers.
Bestow permanent mind control immunity upon the warriors who fought this <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>.
Craft a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> from the eye.

pool: All Ethereal Units (Except Astral Sea Monsters)
stories.title: Warping Tower
text: You enter the dark Fractured Tower. It used to be a grand, stable beacon for all magical beings. But now...

You and your army quickly notice something is off. Without moving, you find yourself at the other end of the hallway, up the stairs... or back at the door. It becomes clear that some force here is warping the tower and displacing its furniture—and everyone in it. Your army scrambles as they find themselves displaced throughout the tower.
Suddenly your troops find themselves standing eye to eye with an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>, before it disappears again. Danger approaches...

options.text: Attack the creatures that haunt the cursed Fractured Tower!
Use your arcane prowess <mana></mana> to delay the displacements.
Connect to the wild flows of the Astral Sea. Use them to your advantage.

check.header: Go with the flow of the Astral Sea:
check.success: Your troops find themselves light on their feet.
check.failure: The flows are too unpredictable.

options.text: Leave the warping Fractured Tower.

aftermath.title: Warping Tower: Aftermath
text: After defeating the creatures in the warping Fractured Tower, some sense of peace returns to the twisted spire.

The tower can now be traversed with relative ease, although the warping continues. Your army tries to collect as many books and riches as they can to stop the objects from popping in and out of existence. You enter the top spire of the tower, where the displacement seems strongest, and find the body of a wizard... warped into a wall.
A failed arcane experiment caused the problems at the tower. What object do you save before it is warped into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]?

options.text: Save the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.
Save the chest filled with riches <gold></gold>.
Save the Ancient Tome.
Save the vat of souls <soul></soul>.

stories.title: Undying Obsession
text: You enter the looming Fractured Tower. Once it was a beacon of magical power. Now only fading remnants are left.

As you ascend the twisting spire, an uncanny feeling overcomes you. Then you notice a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] scurrying through the tower, frantically searching for... something. The Lost Wizard suddenly stops when the Lost Wizard finds a rotting book, picking up the tome with surprising care. The Lost Wizard trembles when the tome crumbles to dust in their tentacles, and releases a blood-curdling scream before continuing their frantic rampage.
When the Lost Wizard notices you, the Lost Wizard rises to their full height, ready to fight off this challenge for their power.

options.text: Kill this Lost Wizard!
Use raw magical prowess <mana></mana> to weaken the Lost Wizard against your attacks.
Call upon your great knowledge of the Astral Sea to weaken this Lost Wizard against your attacks.

check.header: Siphon the power from the Lost Wizard
check.success: The Lost Wizard howls in agony as its defenses are torn away.
check.failure: Nothing happens.

options.text: Take out a book and burn it in front of the Lost Wizard to provoke the Lost Wizard.
Back away and leave the tower.

aftermath.title: Undying Obsession: Aftermath
text: The threat in the Fractured Tower having been dealt with, you are able to search the broken spire yourself.

While rampaging through the tower, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] missed a secret door, one cleverly hidden by the wizard who resided here before. It leads to a well-protected treasury. All of its contents are in a remarkably good condition when compared to the rest of the Fractured Tower. In the center of the room, a floating orb hums and rises when you enter. "Welcome back, master."
A voice emanates from the floating orb, unaware you are not the wizard who resided here. "What shall I retrieve from your treasury today?"

options.text: "Hand me my strongest weapon." <item></item>
"Bring me my wealth." <gold></gold>
"Summon my defenses." <unit></unit>
"Hand me my journals. I wish to learn about... my own domain." <influence></influence>

wonders.name: Giant's Throne
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>All owned [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Provinces[/hyperlink] adjacent to this Ancient Wonder gain +2 <influence></influence> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ImperiumConcept]Imperium[/hyperlink] additional income.</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ROCK_GIANT]Rock Giant[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.STORM_GIANT]Storm Giant[/hyperlink] to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: A palatial monument to a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantsLoreConcept]Giant King of old[/hyperlink], revered as a god by their smallfolk subjects. Richly decorated with gold and black marble, such Thrones are faint echoes of the splendor of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink] that once spanned much of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]. Despite their immeasurable age, these majestic statues display no signs of decay.

stories.title: Primal Prowess
text: You enter the Giant's Throne and find a group of figures worshiping the statue of an ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant King[/hyperlink].

At first, the worshippers don't seem to notice you at all, instead chanting in the ancient language of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink]. It is only when you approach the statue that their leader lifts their gaze. "You are no Giant worshippers. You trespass on hallowed grounds! You dare taint the grand steps of the Giant's Throne with your soldiers?!"
Their leader points at you and shouts: "Great Kings of old! Bless us with your prowess to smite these heretics!"

options.text: "Attack!"
"You want to become giants, you will be felled like them!" <influence></influence>
"The blessing of growth can be granted, but I can take it away."

check.header: Take away the primal energies that empower the cultists:
check.success: You control the energies.
check.failure: This primal power is beyond you.

options.text: "You worship my kin! Bow to me, my followers!"
Leave the cultists to their ceremony.

aftermath.title: Primal Prowess: Aftermath
text: After slaying the worshipers of the Giant's Throne you can freely approach the statue.

No thunder crashes down, no lightning nor divine wrath smites you or your army. Instead, the Giant's Throne lies silent, the grand halls echoing every footstep as the statue looms above the army. At the giant base of the statue, the cultists had gathered a pile of artifacts to worship and sacrifice to their beloved [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant King[/hyperlink].
Without the cultists to protect their treasure, the objects are free to claim.

options.text: Gather everything of value to sell. <gold></gold>
Take the ritual scroll of Colossus' Grace.
Claim the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. <item></item>
Take the tome of ancient lore <knowledge></knowledge> on Giants and their magic.
Claim nothing. This remnant of civilization should be kept intact. <materiumboon></materiumboon>

stories.title: Size Matters
text: Inside the looming Giant's Throne, remnant to the glory of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink], you find a <eventColor>Rock Giant</eventColor>, together with a group of Demigiants.

"Aeons ago, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink] ruled over all lesser races," the Giant boasts to their Demigiant followers. "It is only just that I claim this throne once more, per the natural order." A confused silence falls, and the Giant yells in frustration: "The small follow the big, you fools!" The Demigiants cheer, glad they understand, as the Giant sighs.
The Giant looks up at you as you approach. "Interlopers! This is my throne! Attack them!"

options.text: Attack these lumbering fools!
Confuse the Demigiants with rhetoric <knowledge></knowledge> about Giants and their kin.
"Like the legend of the boy shepherd, we too can slay Giants!"

check.header: Invoke the legend of the boy who slew a giant:
check.success: The legend empowers you!
check.failure: No one knows the tale you speak of.

options.text: "A group of hunters can take down the largest quarry!"

check.header: Motivate your army to stand together:
check.success: Together you can slay the greatest foe.
check.failure: Your army trembles in the shadows of these giant adversaries.

options.text: Leave the Giant and their followers.

aftermath.title: Size Matters: Aftermath
text: You have slain a would-be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant King[/hyperlink] and his followers. With that, the Giant's Throne is yours and can be explored freely.

As you wander the halls you encounter a lone <eventColor>Rock Giant</eventColor>, who raises their arms. "You stomped the Giant? You win. He was mean anyways. Called us dumb. He told me to guard the treasure... But I got bored so I walked around." The demi-giant snickers. "Now he got stomped and I am free."
The lone Demigiant poses no threat to you. What do you ask of the <eventColor>Rock Giant</eventColor>?

options.text: Recruit the Demigiant to your side. <unit></unit>
Demand the Demigiant guide you to their collected treasures. <gold></gold>
"You are free to go, <eventColor>Rock Giant</eventColor>." <goodact></goodact>
Kill the surrendering <eventColor>Rock Giant</eventColor> as an example to your troops. <evilact></evilact>

stories.title: Fractured Sentries
text: A majestic Giant's Throne towers before you, the name of the depicted [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant King[/hyperlink] forgotten in time.

Under the massive throne, you enter a grand hall, your movement echoes through the building. There is no life to be found here. No cobwebs, vermin, or even dust cover the halls. And yet, there is no caretaker to be found... Until you feel a familiar tingle run across your spine—a surge of arcane energy.
Lithorine sentries enter the hall. Arcane waves surge through the building as they hum with power and notice you...

options.text: "Attack these rogue sentries!"
Cast a protective spell <mana></mana> over your army.
Use your arcane knowledge to delay the surges of magic.

check.header: Delay the surges of magic that course through the sentries:
check.success: The waves decrease.
check.failure: Your attempts lead to nothing.

options.text: Invoke the powers of Chaos to taunt and confuse the sentries.

check.header: Taunt the sentries to protect your army:
check.success: The sentries are confused.
check.failure: The sentries focus on the cleanup task at hand.

options.text: Invoke the powers of the Giant's Throne to strengthen the armor of your army.

check.header: Attempt to bolster your army's armor:
check.success: The power of the Giant Kings surges through you.
check.failure: Your attempts crumble.

options.text: Flee the Giant's Throne.

aftermath.title: Fractures Sentries: Aftermath
text: After destroying the Lithorine sentries of the Giant's Throne, you are free to explore the pristine halls.

With the sentries obsessively cleaning and protecting the halls for centuries, everything within was preserved. Clear runes, carvings and rows of books line the walls, sharing a wealth of stories about [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida[/hyperlink]. There are depictions of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink] and their covenants with the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink], the fall of Myrrida and the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TraitorKingsLoreConcept]Traitor Kings[/hyperlink], and even secret legends of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EternalCouncilLoreConcept]Eternal Council[/hyperlink].
Next to the knowledge found within, you find troves of hidden treasure, and even a room of dormant Lithorine sentries.

options.text: Take a weapon covered in crystals. <item></item>
Claim the treasure <gold></gold> found within the Giant's Throne.
Bind some of the sentries on your side. <unit></unit>
Gather the Lithorite crystals. <mana></mana>

wonders.name: Golden Ziggurat
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_ORIGIN]Magic Origin[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] require -50% less <gold></gold> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GoldConcept]Gold[/hyperlink] and <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] base [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept]Unit Upkeep[/hyperlink] in this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PHOENIX]Phoenix[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]The Archon civilization[/hyperlink] raised these monolithic structures at great cost. Scholars speculate they were once utilized as portals to other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink]. However, with the ziggurat's original builders now long gone, those with opportunistic and potentially sinister motives come to try and unravel its forgotten powers.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: Prima Materia
text: Upon entering the Golden Ziggurat, you are greeted by a flustered Transmuter. "Did your research lead you here, too?", the Transmuter asks.

The Transmuter knows your puzzled look all too well. "I am an alchemist," the Transmuter explains, "seeking to create the Prima Materia. I'm about to prove my hypothesis!" The Transmuter turns several gold dials, prompting the Golden Ziggurat to hum and vibrate. "I am sorry," the Transmuter suddenly says. "To make the Prima Materia, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OrderConcept]Order[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium[/hyperlink] must be countered with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink]."
The influx of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink] animates the Golems that line the Golden Ziggurat's walls with fiery intent. "It is the only way," confesses the Transmuter.

options.text: Attack the Transmuter and the hostile Golems!
Magically <mana></mana> protect your army against fire.
Train <unitprod></unitprod> your troops to recognize the fighting patterns of the Golems.
Redirect the influx of Chaos energy to enhance your weaker soldiers.

check.header: Enchant your lower rank warriors with Lesser Rebirth, like the Golems.
check.success: Your warriors adopt the Lesser Rebirth. Not even death can stop them.
check.failure: The Lesser Rebirth enchantment fails to spread among your soldiers.

options.text: Quench the inner flames that augmented the Golems.

check.header: Cool down the Golems' inner clockworks.
check.success: When reviving themselves, the Golems will not erupt in a blaze.
check.failure: Unfortunately, Golem inner flames burn too fierce to be countered.

options.text: Use your control over metals to slowly turn the Golems to gold.

check.header: Attempt to transmute a Golem to become gilded every so often.
check.success: The Golems will to turn into gold, one by one.
check.failure: The Golems, overtaken by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos energy[/hyperlink], resist your attempt.

options.text: Leave the Transmuter and the Golden Ziggurat.

aftermath.title: Prima Materia: Aftermath
text: The Transmuter has been slain. Your army has survived the torrent of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MateriumConcept]Materium[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ChaosConcept]Chaos[/hyperlink].

Despite the treacherous hostility of the Transmuter, the Transmuter spoke no lie. The Golden Ziggurat is a trove of alchemical discoveries. And now, at its center, suspended in mid-air, a transmorphic substance shifts and twists non-stop. The Prima Materia. It will allow you to forge powerful artifacts and weapons.
The Prima Materia is yours, although its full potential is unknown to you. What other boon of creation shall be yours?

options.text: Pilfer the gold <gold></gold> that plates the walls and the Golems.
Take the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> that the Transmuter tucked in their knapsack.
Collect the metals and stone <structureprod></structureprod> that litter the Golden Ziggurat.
Study the alchemical secrets <knowledge></knowledge> of the Golden Ziggurat.

stories.title: Two Dragons
text: The ancient Golden Ziggurat looms before you. Inside you encounter two resting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept]Dragons[/hyperlink] at opposite ends of the hall.

Each dragon seems to be guarding one half of a considerable hoard. "Intruder," the first one, a royal Dragon says. "Thou darest enter my hoard? Leave thy tribute, lest I rain down fiery wrath upon thee!"
The second, a Dragon, glares at the other before turning back to your Hero with a cold grin. "I suggest you run, little Leader."
The two dragons rise, towering above you. "Leave our hoards, or face our wrath!"

options.text: Attack the dragons!
Cast a quick spell <mana></mana> to protect your troops before engaging.
Question whose hoard is bigger, to trigger a fight.

check.header: Attempt to provoke the jealousy of both dragons.
check.success: The dragons start to fight each other!
check.failure: The dragons see through your attempted provocation.

options.text: Flee.

aftermath.title: Two Dragons: Aftermath
text: With the threat of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DragonsLoreConcept]Dragons[/hyperlink] removed, you have gained access to the Golden Ziggurat.

Through the ages they spent in this realm, the dragons had amassed a considerable hoard, its contents meticulously split in half. You even find some broken objects, as if the dragons did not know how to divide the wealth otherwise. Luckily, most of the treasures were kept intact.
The dragons' hoard is yours to take. Which item catches <eventColor>your</eventColor> eye?

options.text: The <eventColor>Ring</eventColor> of the <eventColor>Dragon</eventColor>. <item></item>
The <eventColor>weapon</eventColor> of the <eventColor>Dragon</eventColor>. <item></item>
Repair the broken throne. <influence></influence>
Repair the deactivated Fire Dragon. <unit></unit>

pool: All Ethereal Units (Except Astral Sea Monsters)
All Astral Enchantments Except Tier V
stories.title: Dormant Gate
text: You approach the looming Golden Ziggurat. Its golden halls are lined with statues of ancient [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archons[/hyperlink] looking down upon the visitors.

Before long you and your troops enter a grand hall with a rune-covered arch at the opposite end. It is said these structures were once used as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldGateLoreConcept]gates[/hyperlink] to other worlds, but this one has been dormant for ages... At least, until you step inside. Suddenly the ancient arch crackles with energy and a star-lit vortex appears in its center. Shadows emerge behind the veil...
You realize this is not a way out for you... It's a way in for otherworldly creatures, lurking beyond.

options.text: "Stand fast, troops! We will survive whatever steps through that gate!"
Bolster your troops <mana></mana> against the astral invaders.
"We will hold the Golden Ziggurat, shielded by the miracles of faith!"

check.header: Protect your troops from danger through your divine order.
check.success: Your troops feel bolstered under your command.
check.failure: Your commands don't seem to inspire faith.

options.text: Use the magic that surges through the Golden Ziggurat to empower your own spells.

check.header: Empower yourself through the Golden Ziggurat.
check.success: The power surging through the Gate enhances your magic!
check.failure: Your attempt to tap into ancient powers fails.

options.text: Retreat before the gate opens.

aftermath.title: Dormant Gate: Aftermath
text: You and your troops have survived the onslaught at the Golden Ziggurat. Slowly, the gate closes and the magical energy in the air dissipates.

After catching your breath, you can walk the golden halls with ease. Almost every surface is covered in runes and murals depicting legendary battles and journeys to unknown worlds. It does not take long for eager scholars from your empire to enter the Golden Ziggurat themselves, their muttered debates about its history and potential usages filling the once abandoned halls.
Whilst scholars trickle in to investigate the grand Golden Ziggurat, you can decide how to spend your time before you leave.

options.text: Take the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> which rests in the center of the Golden Ziggurat.
Loot the Golden Ziggurat <gold></gold>.
"This Golden Ziggurat will be my beacon of power <influence></influence>."
Stay and learn from the legends covering the golden walls.

wonders.name: Lost Wizard Tower
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unlock the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WIZARD_BOMBARDMENT]Wizard's Bombardment[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept]Siege Project[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BONE_DRAGON]Bone Dragon[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>This crumbled spire was once a mighty Archmage's seat of power. It is constructed in a style often favored by the Wizards of the Circle of Evermore. While some powerful force seems to have destroyed the tower and long vanquished its owner, dangerously arcane energies still seep from within the ruins.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: Forlorn Puppeteer
text: You enter the Lost Wizard Tower with healthy trepidation. A voice, eerily devoid of emotion, rings out: "Help us. You must help us."

A Lost Wizard looks straight at you, their expression blank. Other mages and warriors are huddled together in the Tower's shadowy hall. "Yes. Come closer. You must help us," speaks a Lost Wizard, but you again detect no spirit in their voice. More hollow-eyed people shamble towards the center of the hall. A hoarse hiss from the darkest shadows then draws your attention.
From the shadows, an <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> puppeteers the Lost Wizard and the other victims, who draw their weapons silently to attack you.

options.text: Attack the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> and their unwilling flock.
Break <mana></mana> the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s hold over the Lost Wizard.
Let your stupefying glory <influence></influence> shield your warrior from the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s dominance.
"Our faith is stronger than this cretin's dark curse."

check.header: Attempt to protect Faithful warriors from domination effects.
check.success: Your zeal successfully shields your army's sanity.
check.failure: The power of the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> proves greater than your faith.

options.text: Convert one of the mind controlled warriors to your side.

check.header: Seize control of one of the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s victim's broken mind:
check.success: One of the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s slaves obeys your commands during battle.
check.failure: The <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s hold over their minions is too fierce to break.

options.text: Leave the Lost Wizard Tower before your army falls to the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s spell.

aftermath.title: Forlorn Puppeteer: Aftermath
text: You felled the puppeteering <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> and their victims.

Released from the foul creature's control, surviving <eventColor>Lost Wizards</eventColor> vacantly shamble throughout the Lost Wizard Tower. You ignore them. Instead, you look to investigate how this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] gained mind-controlling abilities. As you study the corpse, a third eye suddenly pops open in the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s forehead. You wonder if this particular <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor> had been enthralled by [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowDemonsLoreConcept]Umbral Demons[/hyperlink] before arriving in this realm.
You carve out the <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>'s third eye and spend some time studying it. What will you focus on?

options.text: Restore the sanity of the ambling <eventColor>Lost Wizards</eventColor> <unit></unit> and recruit them.
Assimilate the Lost Wizard's mutation <evilact></evilact> to gain <unitHero></unitHero> domination powers.
Bestow permanent mind control immunity upon the warriors who fought this <eventColor>enemy leader</eventColor>.
Craft a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> from the eye.

pool: All Ethereal Units (Except Astral Sea Monsters)
