stories.title: Warping Tower
text: You enter the dark Lost Wizard Tower. It used to be a grand, stable beacon for all magical beings. But now...

You and your army quickly notice something is off. Without moving, you find yourself at the other end of the hallway, up the stairs... or back at the door. It becomes clear that some force here is warping the tower and displacing its furniture—and everyone in it. Your army scrambles as they find themselves displaced throughout the tower.
Suddenly your troops find themselves standing eye to eye with an <eventColor>enemy</eventColor>, before it disappears again. Danger approaches...

options.text: Attack the creatures that haunt the cursed Lost Wizard Tower!
Use your arcane prowess <mana></mana> to delay the displacements.
Connect to the wild flows of the Astral Sea. Use them to your advantage.

check.header: Go with the flow of the Astral Sea:
check.success: Your troops find themselves light on their feet.
check.failure: The flows are too unpredictable.

options.text: Leave the warping Lost Wizard Tower.

aftermath.title: Warping Tower: Aftermath
text: After defeating the creatures in the warping Lost Wizard Tower, some sense of peace returns to the twisted spire.

The tower can now be traversed with relative ease, although the warping continues. Your army tries to collect as many books and riches as they can to stop the objects from popping in and out of existence. You enter the top spire of the tower, where the displacement seems strongest, and find the body of a wizard... warped into a wall.
A failed arcane experiment caused the problems at the tower. What object do you save before it is warped into the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept]Astral Sea[/hyperlink]?

options.text: Save the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.
Save the chest filled with riches <gold></gold>.
Save the Ancient Tome.
Save the vat of souls <soul></soul>.

stories.title: Undying Obsession
text: You enter the looming Lost Wizard Tower. Once it was a beacon of magical power. Now only fading remnants are left.

As you ascend the twisting spire, an uncanny feeling overcomes you. Then you notice a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] scurrying through the tower, frantically searching for... something. The Lost Wizard suddenly stops when the Lost Wizard finds a rotting book, picking up the tome with surprising care. The Lost Wizard trembles when the tome crumbles to dust in their tentacles, and releases a blood-curdling scream before continuing their frantic rampage.
When the Lost Wizard notices you, the Lost Wizard rises to their full height, ready to fight off this challenge for their power.

options.text: Kill this Lost Wizard!
Use raw magical prowess <mana></mana> to weaken the Lost Wizard against your attacks.
Call upon your great knowledge of the Astral Sea to weaken this Lost Wizard against your attacks.

check.header: Siphon the power from the Lost Wizard
check.success: The Lost Wizard howls in agony as its defenses are torn away.
check.failure: Nothing happens.

options.text: Take out a book and burn it in front of the Lost Wizard to provoke the Lost Wizard.
Back away and leave the tower.

aftermath.title: Undying Obsession: Aftermath
text: The threat in the Lost Wizard Tower having been dealt with, you are able to search the broken spire yourself.

While rampaging through the tower, the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LostWizardLoreConcept]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] missed a secret door, one cleverly hidden by the wizard who resided here before. It leads to a well-protected treasury. All of its contents are in a remarkably good condition when compared to the rest of the Lost Wizard Tower. In the center of the room, a floating orb hums and rises when you enter. "Welcome back, master."
A voice emanates from the floating orb, unaware you are not the wizard who resided here. "What shall I retrieve from your treasury today?"

options.text: "Hand me my strongest weapon." <item></item>
"Bring me my wealth." <gold></gold>
"Summon my defenses." <unit></unit>
"Hand me my journals. I wish to learn about... my own domain." <influence></influence>

wonders.name: Rose Choked Palace
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] ignores the <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityStabilityConcept]City Stability[/hyperlink] penalty of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SunlessConcept]Sunless[/hyperlink] in its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ROSE_KNIGHT]Rose Knight[/hyperlink] and various Rose Choked Skeleton units to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Imposing mansions raised long ago by dark overlords, the overgrowth of crimson roses and thorny vines suggests abandonment and disrepair. Yet at night, flickering lights appear behind red-stained glass windows, suggesting that not all life—or indeed unlife—has vacated the palace's grand halls and labyrinthian courtyards.

stories.title: Rose of Thorns
text: You lead your army into the dead quiet courtyard of an ancient palace. The courtyard is overgrown with rose vines.

At the far edge of the courtyard, a beautiful woman lies motionless on a bed of stone. A decomposed spinning wheel stands nearby, its spindle stained by blood as red as the roses that cover the courtyard. You note the remains of <eventColor>Thorned Skeleton Archers</eventColor> beneath the vines, thorns fused to their bones. When you take a step forward, the dead rise.
The <eventColor>Thorned Skeleton Archers</eventColor>, led by a Rose Knight, won't let you go near the beautiful sleeper. How do you respond?

options.text: Attack the Rose Knight to save the beautiful sleeper.
Before attacking, ignite the rose bushes with simple spellcraft. <mana></mana>
Manipulate the roses. Make them lose their thorns.

check.header: Attempt to dethorn the creeping rose vines:
check.success: The rose vines lose their thorns and no longer harm your army.
check.failure: The thorns endure, fortified by magic stronger than yours

options.text: Summon cold winds to wither the thorny vines in the Rose Choked Palace.

check.header: Wither the creeping vines that cover the courtyard.
check.success: Half of the vines in the courtyard wither away.
check.failure: The creeping vines resisted your cold winds.

options.text: Let the beauty sleep and leave the Rose Choked Palace.

aftermath.title: Rose of Thorns: Aftermath
text: With the Rose Knight reduced to thorny bones and armor, you approach the beautiful sleeper on the stone bed.

You lean forward to inspect if the sleeper still lives. As your breath touches the man's lips, <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> opens their eyes and gasps. "Greetings, Hero," <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> sighs. "Cursed I was by a witch, jealous of my youth and skill. I am <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>." <eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> looks around. "Is this my father's castle? It seems... I was asleep for a very long time."
The curse is broken. The magic of the Rose Choked Palace wanes and the vines crumble. Before departing, what trophy will you claim?

options.text: Recruit <unitHero></unitHero> <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>, now awakened.
Let your scholars chronicle <knowledge></knowledge> <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>'s memories from yesteryear.
Let <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> go. Pick up the Rose Knight's <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. <item></item>
Harvest the lingering magical power <mana></mana> of the Rose Choked Palace.

stories.title: Queen of Banshees
text: You enter the courtyard of an ancient and forgotten palace. A woman stands weeping before the statue of a king.

The statue is defiled with blood. Scratches, as if made by fingernails, run over the eyes of the man. The wailing woman whips their head around when the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> hears your army approach. "Have you come to mock the Banshee Queen," the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> whimpers. "Poor <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>, betrayed by their husband, that King of Cheats." The <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> bares their fangs as <eventColor>Banshees</eventColor> appear around the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>.

"My adulterous husband died before receiving punishment, but my scorn will be suffered." the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s sudden scream shatters the statue, before the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> lunges at you.

options.text: "Time to silence the Banshee Queen. Charge!"
A reward <gold></gold> for whoever brings me the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s head!
Conjure a visage of the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s adulterous spouse.

check.header: Summon a spectral illusion of the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s husband, as if he were still alive:
check.success: <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> and their <eventColor>Banshees</eventColor> shriek and briefly cower from despair.
check.failure: <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> sends their <eventColor>Banshees</eventColor> flying through the visage to attack you.

options.text: Disguise yourself as the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s dead husband.

check.header: <eventColor>Your Hero</eventColor> takes on the guise of the Banshee Queen's husband:
check.success: "You?!", <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> wails. "Attack my cheating husband first!"
check.failure: Your illusions have no effect. <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor> hisses: "Have I not been deceived sufficiently?"

options.text: Flee the Rose Choked Palace and the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s scorn.

aftermath.title: Queen of Banshees: Aftermath
text: The Queen of Banshees lies at your feet. Her heart now at rest. Her wailing finally stopped.

The few <eventColor>Banshees</eventColor> that remain, scatter to hide in the darkest corners of the Rose Choked Palace. They were drawn to the <eventColor>Banshee</eventColor>'s scorn centuries ago and had driven her mad. When you survey the opulent palace chambers for treasures and antiquities, you discover the decayed bodies of servants. Their throats are marked by long and deep cuts made by claws. Or fingernails.
Eager to leave the dark tragedies of the Rose Choked Palace behind you, what memento will you take from the palace?

options.text: Restore the husband's statue <influence></influence> to be placed at your court.
Bind one of the wandering <eventColor>Banshees</eventColor> to join <unit></unit> your army.
Extract the dormant souls <souls></souls> that linger in the Rose Choked Palace.
Give the Banshee Queen a proper burial. <goodact></goodact>

stories.title: Bloodmoon Banquet
text: While readying your army to explore a Rose Choked Palace, outwardly abandoned and overgrown, you hear music.

Peering through tall windows of red-stained glass, you discover a coven of Vampires feasting in the palace courtyard. They fill wine glasses with the blood of bound mortals, hung upside down and force-fed ale. The intoxicated Vampires revel in the light that enters the courtyard through the red-stained windows, and toast the Bloodmoon and the supremacy of their kind.
A <eventColor>Vampire Spider Hatchling</eventColor> notices you peeping in. All Vampires, sobering up at a moment's notice, turn to face you, poised to strike.

options.text: Charge into the courtyard to slay the Vampires.
Wield your piety to purify the dreadful light.

check.header: Attempt to bend the devious red light into a Holy Aura:
check.success: When the red light touches <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>, it empowers <eventColor>your</eventColor> sanctity.
check.failure: The malicious light refuses to bend to your piety.

options.text: Crack the red-stained glass of the windows.

check.header: Break the Bloodglass windows to scatter the malicious light:
check.success: The cracked glass permits fewer Bloodmoon rays to pass through it.
check.failure: Your summoned tremors fail to crack the Bloodglass windows.

options.text: Run away before the Vampires confront you.

aftermath.title: Bloodmoon Banquet: Aftermath
text: After thrashing the Vampire revels, you free their blood-drained prisoners. Among of them are <eventColor>Vampire Spider Hatchlings</eventColor> of your <eventColor>race</eventColor>!

"Praise to you, O <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>!", the least drained <eventColor>Vampire Spider Hatchling</eventColor> sighs. "I had very little more blood to give." You investigate the palace grounds. The Vampires were feeding on the captured prisoners, yet their palace was stocked with the finest quality viands to fatten their blood suppliers. It would be a shame to let the feast go to waste.
The rescued <eventColor>Vampire Spider Hatchlings</eventColor> are eager to serve you in battle. Before you depart, what purpose will the Rose Choked Palace stockpiles serve?

options.text: Plunder the stockpiled provisions <food></food> for <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Send the palatial vittles to your recruits <unitprod></unitprod> in <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Allow your victorious army to finish the banquet. <morale></morale> They earned it.
Study the Bloodmoon Ritual to empower <xp></xp> <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>.
Enthrall <thralls></thralls> the other rescued prisoners. <evilact></evilact>

wonders.name: Vaultsphere
wonders.description: Unlocks Crack the Vault, a single-use action which trades 500 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResearchConcept]Research[/hyperlink] for 500 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink].Unlocks the Summon Progenitor Golem combat spell.
wonders.lore: A mysterious dome-like structure built by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept]Ancient Krazura[/hyperlink]. Inside, a dormant environment dwells in magical stasis, as the last glimpse of a world long lost. While the original purpose of the Vaultsphere became forgotten with its creators, many aspiring factions have attempted to use the realm fragments sealed inside as experimental chambers of their own.

pool: All Materium Except Tier V Enchantments
stories.title: Touch of My'dhas
text: Upon entering the Vaultsphere, you shield your eyes from the blinding sunlight bouncing off white sands and golden idols.

You are inside an arena, amidst a dozen gold statues. Most of them are rooted in gold puddles that spot the white sandy plains. Soldiers. Servants. Beasts. Furniture and food. All wrought from gold—Wait! Did that statue just move?! Then, you hear snickering. "My, my," a raspy voice resounds throughout the arena. "Have they lifted my exile at last?"
A luxuriously garbed [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard King[/hyperlink] reveals themselves: "I am <eventColor>Golden Golem</eventColor>, God of Wealth! Take my hand and stay a while!"

options.text: "You may take my cold steel, <eventColor>Golden Golem</eventColor>!"
Those puddles of gold seem treacherous! Cast preemptive counter spells. <mana></mana>
Mutter an incantation to shield your troops from unexpected aureate hexes.

check.header: Attempt to resist My'dhas's golden magics:
check.success: The gilded afflictions of My'dhas barely affect your troops!
check.failure: You fail to protect your troops from My'dhas's golden touch.

options.text: No, thanks! Retreat from this gilded realm and seal the gate.

aftermath.title: Touch of My'dhas: Aftermath
text: Your warriors proved more than <eventColor>(the god's name)</eventColor> and <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> golden host bargained for. The impoverished [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WizardKingLoreConcept]Wizard King[/hyperlink] lies at your feet.

"Not quite... hnng! ... the golden destiny I had coined for myself," the fallen [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GodirLoreConcept]Godir[/hyperlink] smirks through the pain. "How precious! First, my rivals enviously seal me away." My'dhas coughs up gold blood. "And when my prison opens next, vault robbers arrive to raid my treasures!" The self-proclaimed God of Wealth spits scornfully. "Take my riches. May you choke on them."
As My'dhas spends <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> final breaths, your troops collect <eventColor>the god's</eventColor> hoard. How else will you profit from My'dhas's demise?

options.text: Procure the radiant <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. <item></item>
Extract the enchantment <mana></mana> from My'dhas's bewitched body.
Reanimate <unit></unit> an intact <eventColor>Golden Golem</eventColor> that remained dormant.
Steal a fraction of My'dhas's enchantment to create a <eventColor>Golden Golem</eventColor>. <unit></unit>

stories.title: Contained Constructs
text: After stepping into the Vaultsphere, you find yourself on an ancient, dusty plateau of stone and steel.

Soon, you discern lumbering shapes of <eventColor>Heralds of War</eventColor> and other machines. One scratches at a column and, judging from the groove's depth, has done so for centuries. Another marches jerkily in tight circles. Suddenly, someone loudly trips over a steel plate that a <eventColor>Herald of War</eventColor> dropped! The machines take notice. One by one, their heads rotate towards your troops, locking onto targets.

Rejected constructs shamble towards <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>. A <eventColor>Herald of War</eventColor> trips and promptly explodes in a fountain of molten steel. Will <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor> attack?

options.text: Permanently put the defective constructs out of commission!
Affix <structureprod></structureprod> scattered pieces of <eventColor>Herald of War</eventColor> plates to your armor for protection.
Enchant the constructs' heads to rotate and lock onto yourself.

check.header: Have the advancing machines be [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TAUNTED]taunted[/hyperlink] by <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>, decreasing their accuracy:
check.success: The hostile constructs are forced to target <eventColor>your Hero</eventColor>.
check.failure: Your attempt misfires, inadvertently improving the discarded constructs' aim.

options.text: Retreat for now and seal up the machines again.

aftermath.title: Contained Constructs: Aftermath
text: For the first time in centuries, silence returns to the ancient Vaultsphere. The constructs are finally still and at peace.

You investigate the ancient site. Faded glyphs and colorful mosaics reveal to you that the plateau was created by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept]Ancient Krazura[/hyperlink], but later used to detain constructs that showed defects, were overtly volatile, or that were discarded for other reasons. Upon entering the long-forgotten repository, the decaying constructs' behavior modules immediately assumed your troops were acute threats.
As your troops clear out the Vaultsphere, you permit yourself to take one of the machines' treasures. Which one?

options.text: Take the ancient <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>.
Haul away the copious gold armor pieces <gold></gold> that litter the floors.
Reanimate <unit></unit> an immobilized <eventColor>Herald of War</eventColor>.
Learn the secret of <eventColor>spell</eventColor> by studying the exploded constructs.

stories.title: Sequestered Developments
text: You step through the gate of the Vaultsphere and are engulfed by a sea of lush leaves and warm winds.

A writhing cacophony of birdsong welcomes you. You breathe in the humid air and experience a pull, as if propelled forward. You sense movement in the nearby undergrowth. A small critter leaps out and agonizingly evolves into a <eventColor>Goretusk Piglet</eventColor> before your very eyes! Then, without warning, a gale topples nearby trees. An enormous Construct lands in the clearing it created.

A tinny-voiced Progenitor Golem snarls:
"What goes on no legs in the morning,
four legs in the afternoon,
and wings in the evening? Answer me!"

options.text: "Nothing I can't kill! Attack!"
"I know this! <knowledge></knowledge> "Dragon" is the answer! Adjust your defenses, troops!"
A rapidly developing dragon? Nature's laws forbid your forced evolution!

check.header: Command the Progenitor Golem to respect the natural laws of evolution:
check.success: The creatures of the Vaultsphere resist the forced evolution of the Progenitor Golem.
check.failure: Your efforts only strengthen the creatures that the Progenitor Golem manipulates!

options.text: "Whatever it is, it won't catch us today! Retreat!"

aftermath.title: Sequestered Developments: Aftermath
text: Its creatures defeated and wings clipped, the <eventColor>Goretusk Piglet</eventColor> shrieks with the sound of steel wire twining, then crashes to earth.

It lifts its head one last time and speaks: "Your puzzled expression amuses me. Have you not invaded my domain to steal my secrets? My creators, praise their feathers, tasked me to protect this hidden sanctuary. I adapted myself and those I was tasked to protect... And still I failed." The <eventColor>Goretusk Piglet</eventColor> sighs, and you are reminded of an iron flagpole creaking in a storm.
"One final riddle remains", the <eventColor>Goretusk Piglet</eventColor> groans. "What mortal bounty should I bequeath unto you?"

options.text: Learn the spell of <eventColor>spell</eventColor>!
Request the verdant <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor>. <item></item>
A <eventColor>Goretusk Piglet</eventColor> for your army. <unit></unit>

wonders.name: Withered Tree
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+1 <food></food> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FoodConcept]Food[/hyperlink] and +1 <structureprod></structureprod> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StructureProductionConcept]Production[/hyperlink] per [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ProvinceConcept]Province[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SandConcept]Sand[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralBarrensConcept]Astral Barrens[/hyperlink] in the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.CARRION_BIRD]Carrion Bird[/hyperlink] unit to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Unlocks the Restore action which turns this [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AncientWonderConcept]Ancient Wonder[/hyperlink] into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WORLD_TREE]World Tree[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: Only this wooden carcass remains of a mighty [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WORLD_TREE]World Tree[/hyperlink], which are attestations to life's unbridled resilience. Its roots once grew deep and far, its boughs high and long; nourishing, healing, and protecting all that lives and grows in between. Hence, the death of a World Tree, which only an earth-shattering force could wreak, is an affront to life itself.

stories.title: Wormed Wood
text: The Withered Tree looming over you and your army is hollow, and riddled with holes. Tracks leads into the cavernous trunk.

You find a spooked <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> inside. Suddenly, the earth beneath your feet trembles. The <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> looks at the ground frantically... and then disappears in a fountain of dirt. The tumult drives vermin and critters from the decaying wood of the Withered Tree, looking to feed. The ground then begins to tremble once more.
A great <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> bursts from the ground, threatening you. Will you stand and fight, or flee for your life?

options.text: Exterminate the pests that infest the Withered Tree.
Tread slowly and irregularly to disrupt the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor>'s detection of your army.
Detect the underground movements of the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor>.

check.header: Feel out the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor>'s movements to avoid its attacks:
check.success: You can sense when and where the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> will emerge.
check.failure: The earth is unwilling to disclose its secrets to you.

options.text: Nurture the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor>'s desire to consume:

check.header: Push the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> to swallow prey indiscriminately, including their allies:
check.success: The <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> hungers. The <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> will swallow all that the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> catches from below.
check.failure: The <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> refuses to be coerced. Only your troops will be eaten.

options.text: Take your leave from the infested Withered Tree.

aftermath.title: Wormed Wood: Aftermath
text: Most of the vermin that wormed their way inside the Withered Tree have been exterminated. The Withered Tree may be explored.

Armor and weapons are half-buried in the dirt. This Withered Tree was a death trap: the very hunting grounds of colossal <eventColor>Caustic Worms</eventColor>. These discarded armaments lured in unwitting prey, scavenging for treasure before being devoured by the <eventColor>Caustic Worms</eventColor>. Already the ground tremors again as the largest <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor> burrows through the soil, soon to re-emerge and devour more prey.
Your troops collect the discarded armor and weapons. What else may they claim from the Withered Tree before the <eventColor>Caustic Worms</eventColor> return?

options.text: Ship the lumber <structureprod></structureprod> that fell off the dead trunk to <eventColor>your city</eventColor>.
Trap and tame <unit></unit> one of the <eventColor>Caustic Worms</eventColor>.
Fashion a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> from the dead the <eventColor>Caustic Worm</eventColor>'s chitin.
Secure the best armaments for your army to upgrade <xp></xp> their equipment.

stories.title: Sapped and Fractured
text: You stand in the long shadow of a Withered Tree. Entities feed on the last of its remaining magical energies.

Where once a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.STRUCTURES.WORLD_TREE]World Tree[/hyperlink] bloomed, now stands a husk, drained of its magic. The creatures feeding on it are known as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink]: profoundly deprived of enchantments and mana, haunted by a limitless hunger to consume magic. They sapped all life and energy from the Withered Tree, yet still continue to suck the last traces of power from its dry and dead roots.
A Fractured Dragon senses your magical aura and turns to you with a roar. Will you risk an assault?

options.text: Attack the Fractured Dragon and their Mana Starved host.
Cover yourself in mana crystals <mana></mana> to taunt the Fractured Dragon.
Let your holy might grow your warriors' strength.

check.header: Bestow your divine benedictions upon your warriors:
check.success: Your army is inspired by your zeal to fight with increased power.
check.failure: Your followers fail to become overly inspired by your piety.

options.text: Feed the Mana Starved creatures corrupted magic.

check.header: Bombard your opponents with dark energies that harm those who consume it:
check.success: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink] creatures gorge on the wicked magic that enfeebles them.
check.failure: This Fractured Dragon devours even magic from corrupted sources without issue.

options.text: Flee the Withered Tree.

aftermath.title: Sapped and Fractured: Aftermath
text: Your army finally bested the Fractured Dragon and the other [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink] creatures, driven mad by their craving for magic.

Your troops pack up the Fractured Dragon's head to be mounted above your seat in <eventColor>your city</eventColor>. Meanwhile, you gaze upon the Withered Tree to take in the utter devastation, spotting a <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> lodged in the drained wood. Madness is all that remains here. And yet... witnessing the ferocity and strength of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink] makes you wonder if it may lead your <eventColor>race</eventColor> to greatness.
Even without its sappers, the Withered Tree is too dangerous a place to stay. What should you salvage before leaving?

options.text: Dislodge the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> from the trunk of the Withered Tree.
Steel your army's resolve against the Mana Starved onslaught.
Celebrate <xp></xp> your prowess in battle.
Sacrifice your magic to turn your <eventColor>race</eventColor> Mana Starved. <knowledge></knowledge>
Study the aberrant magic <knowledge></knowledge> of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_STARVED]Mana Starved[/hyperlink] entities.

wonders.name: World Tree
wonders.description: <bulletlist><bullet>+2 <mana></mana> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ManaConcept]Mana[/hyperlink] and +2 <knowledge></knowledge> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.KnowledgeConcept]Knowledge[/hyperlink] per <forester></forester> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ForesterConcept]Forester[/hyperlink] in [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CityConcept]City[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DomainConcept]Domain[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Adds [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ENTWINED_THRALL_UNIT]Entwined Thrall[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ENTWINED_PROTECTOR_UNIT]Entwined Protector[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ENTWINED_SCOURGE_UNIT]Entwined Scourge[/hyperlink] to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept]Rally of the Lieges[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>
wonders.lore: <lorefontsize><lorefont>Scripture describes how the First Elves visited all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept]Worlds[/hyperlink] to seed them with life. This magnificent tree stands as a testament to that age. It is said the souls of these First Ones still reside within it, sometimes manifesting themselves as the Entwined, eternally bound to protect its growth.</lorefont></lorefontsize>

stories.title: Thundered Timber
text: Lighting strikes the ground, not a stone's throw from where you stands. Another bolt hits the towering World Tree before you.

The <eventColor>Storm Giants</eventColor>, no longer content with flattening mountains, have set their eyes on the World Tree. They besiege it with the intent of felling it entirely in accordance to their efforts to reshape the realm. They brought thunder, lightning, and axes, along with a host of electrifying beasts.
"Walk away!", bellows a Storm Giant that spots you. "If you interfere, our thunderous fury will strike you too!"

options.text: Attack the <eventColor>Storm Giants</eventColor> and their beasts!
Manipulate <mana></mana> the storms to hit the <eventColor>Storm Giants</eventColor> first.
Command lightning to hasten your warriors if it hits them.

check.header: Invite lightning to become your quickening ally.
check.success: Being struck by lightning hastens your warriors.
check.failure: The lightning declines your invitation and rages on.

options.text: Ask the World Tree to help your warriors resist the storm.

check.header: Draw power from the World Tree to increase your army's resistance.
check.success: Your fighters' bodies resist lightning like tree bark.
check.failure: The besieged World Tree cannot protect you at this time.

options.text: Ground your troops to protect them from the lightning.

check.header: Channel the earth itself to deflect lightning.
check.success: The ground absorbs some of the lightning damage.
check.failure: The earth protects you against lightning, yet slows your warriors.

options.text: Call forth the cold to infuse the raging thunderstorm with frost.

check.header: Conjure snow and ice within the stormy winds.
check.success: The winds of winter flay all units on the battlefield.
check.failure: The thunderstorm cannot be manipulated and persists unchanged.

options.text: Heed the Storm Giant's warning and walk away.

aftermath.title: Thundered Timber: Aftermath
text: The World Tree still stands, which is more than you can say about the <eventColor>Storm Giants</eventColor> and their followers.

The thunderous horde of the <eventColor>Storm Giants</eventColor> are dead or scattered. A few <eventColor>Thunderbirds</eventColor> roost in the canopy of the World Tree, which survived the siege despite manifold scorch marks and broken branches. And several axes still stuck in its trunk. The surrounding fields crackle with weaponry infused with lightning that litter the grasslands like autumn leaves after a storm.
You collect the fallen timber and look for a memento or prize to commemorate the siege of the World Tree.

options.text: Display a broken branch <influence></influence> in <eventColor>your city</eventColor> to commemorate today's achievement.
Pick up the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> that the Storm Giant chieftain dropped.
Tame two <eventColor>Thunderbirds</eventColor> <unit></unit> that flutter nearby still.
Harness the lingering lightning force to augment your weaponry.

stories.title: Corrupted Guardian
text: While approaching the majestic World Tree, you are stopped by a regal <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> emerging from a hut nearby.

<eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> greets you warmly. "I bid thee well, o <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. My fellow Guardians of the Tree and I once saved it from being destroyed by demons, undead and even mortals. Now, though, an unexpected enemy threatens us... one of our own! Corruption has taken hold of the Horned God, who has taken to consuming the life of the Tree itself."
Their pensive gaze shifts to the World Tree. "I do not ask this lightly, o <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>... But this corrupted Horned God must be stopped."

options.text: "I will free the World Tree from this corrupted Horned God."
"Grant me the World Tree's support <mana></mana> and I will protect it."
Call upon the power of the World Tree yourself.

check.header: Root yourself and connect to the World Tree
check.success: You feel the life of the tree surge through you and your army.
check.failure: The World Tree does not answer your call for aid.

options.text: Back away.

aftermath.title: Corrupted Guardian: Aftermath
text: The wise <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> greets you after the sounds of battle have faded. "Thank you. Now the World Tree can heal once more."

"I know you seek resources to strengthen your forces," <eventColor>The Hero</eventColor> says, before <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> looks upon the fallen enemies who once stood with <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>. "... Obsession corrupts the purest of souls. Be careful that your quest for power does not corrupt the things you once cherished. Even the grandest tree will fall when its roots are rotting."
Then <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor> smiles. "Enough lectures. The World Tree and its guardians are indebted to you, o <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>. State your wish."

options.text: "I seek for my population in <eventColor>your city</eventColor> to grow <food></food> with the Tree's blessing."
"I seek aid <unit></unit> from the other guardians of the World Tree."
"Do not lecture me on greed. Give me the <eventColor>Hero Item</eventColor> <item></item> your corrupted guardian carried." <evilact></evilact>
"Allow me to commune <natureboon></natureboon> with the Tree, noble <eventColor>the Hero</eventColor>."

stories.title: Poison and Protection
text: The majestic World Tree unfurls before you, light shimmering through its leaves. Something stirs in the canopy.

"Help! Help! Great <eventColor>Leader</eventColor>! Help!" Scampering down the massive tree's trunk are <eventColor>Entwined Scourges</eventColor>, their cheeks streaked with tears. Their pointy ears twitch as they cry out to you. "Please help us! The poisonous <eventColor>Entwined Scourge</eventColor> and their horrid friends assault our treetop den and seek to consume our friends and our babies..."
Casting your eyes upward, you see shadows writhing in the branches, rapidly descending. The poor <eventColor>Entwined Scourge</eventColor> looks at you, pleading for help.

options.text: Aid the fairies, and attack the <eventColor>Entwined Scourge</eventColor>!
Search for an antidote <food></food> against the poisonous <eventColor>Entwined Scourge</eventColor>.
Use your knowledge about poison to create an antidote to the <eventColor>Entwined Scourge</eventColor>.

check.header: Attempt to create an antidote against poison:
check.success: No poison can harm you.
check.failure: Your army becomes weaker rather than stronger!

options.text: Leave the pleading fairies and the World Tree.

aftermath.title: Poison and Protection: Aftermath
text: With the immediate menace vanquished, tiny voices in the treetops sing your praises.

You also notice various animals emerging from hiding spots, including a <eventColor>mount</eventColor>. The animals whoop and howl and the fairies sing: "<eventColor>Leader</eventColor> of the broken branches, thank you for your deliverance. Let us sing your praises now, and reward you with equivalence!"
"Make a wish, and if it's true, this reward will be for you!"

options.text: "I wish for the poisonous power I fought." <item></item>
"I wish to ride the <eventColor>mount</eventColor> <mount></mount> during my adventures!"
"I wish for aid <unit></unit> of the creatures of the World Tree."
"I only wish for all creatures to be safe." <goodact></goodact>

1167_84_racename.name: Touched by My'dhas
1167_84_racename.description:
My'dhas' units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GILDED]Gilded[/hyperlink] at the start of combat.
Each 2 a defending unit stops being [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GILDED]Gilded[/hyperlink].

My'dhas' [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MeleeConcept]Melee[/hyperlink] attacks have 60% chance to inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GILDED]Gilded[/hyperlink].

acidic_vapours.name: Acidic Pools
acidic_vapours.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a few positions become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONOUS]Poisonous[/hyperlink] for 3 turns. All defending units are immune to the poison effect.

altered_guile.name: Altered Guile
altered_guile.description: If a defending unit is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.OBSCURED]Obscured[/hyperlink] or in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MistConcept]Mist[/hyperlink] cloud at the end of its turn, it gains a random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept]Negative Status Effect[/hyperlink].

arcanum_nimue_summon.name: Aid of Nature
arcanum_nimue_summon.description: A [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FLORAL_STINGER]Floral Stinger[/hyperlink] joins your side during the battle.

artica01.name: Slowed Army Battle
artica01.description: The attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

artica02.name: Frost Resistance Army
artica02.description: The attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] gain +3 <defensefrost></defensefrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostResistanceConcept]Frost Protection[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

avertyoureyes.name: Avert your Eyes!
avertyoureyes.description: All attacking units become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] but gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMUMESEDUCED]Immune to Seduced[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

banshee_queen.name: Banshee Queen
banshee_queen.description:
The defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink]'s attacks inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TORMENT]Torment[/hyperlink].

In Addition, Wailing Pods obstacles adorn her garden, which trigger a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WAIL_OF_THE_BANSHEE]Wail of the Banshee[/hyperlink] when destroyed.

benevolent_blood_parasites.name: Benevolent Blood Parasites
benevolent_blood_parasites.description: All defending units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BENEVOLENT_BLOOD_PARASITE]Benevolent Blood Parasite[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

berserk_blood_parasites.name: Berserk Blood Parasites
berserk_blood_parasites.description: All defending units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK_BLOOD_PARASITE]Benevolent Blood Parasite[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

berserk_enemies.name: Berserk Defenders
berserk_enemies.description: At the start of battle, all defending units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

bhajif01.name: Magic Disruption
bhajif01.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>Attackers have a base 60% chance of becoming:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink] for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_DRAINED]Mana Drained[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist></bullet><bullet>Combat Spells cannot be cast for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

bhajif03.name: Mana Disrupting Magic
bhajif03.description: The attacker's [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mage Units[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MAGIC_FIGHTER]Magic Fighter Units[/hyperlink], and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]Support Units[/hyperlink] attacks gain a 30/60/90/120% chance of inflicting:<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISRUPTION_TOOLTIP_PROPERTY]Disrupted[/hyperlink] for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MANA_DRAINED]Mana Drained[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>Increased for Single Shots.

blinded_moth.name: Sensory Overload
blinded_moth.description: At the start of combat, the Primordial Moth is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

bloodlight_reflections.name: Bloodstone Reflections
bloodlight_reflections.description:
Every [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], several 1-hex areas gain Bloodlight for 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] units in Bloodlight gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink] at the end of the Turn.

bloodlight_refraction.name: Bloodlight Refraction
bloodlight_refraction.description:
Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] refracts Bloodlight.

When ending their turn, they remove Bloodlight in a 1-hex radius.
If they remove any Bloodlight this way, they gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REFLECTION_SPIRIT_SHIELD]Lesser Spirit Shield[/hyperlink] for 3.

bolstered_armor_army.name: Defensive Attackers
bolstered_armor_army.description: All attacking units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_DEFENSE]Bolstered Defense[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

bolstered_resistance_army.name: Resistant Attackers
bolstered_resistance_army.description: All attacking units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BOLSTERED_RESISTANCE]Bolstered Resistance[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

bolstered_status_resistance_army.name: Bolstered Status Resistance Attackers
bolstered_status_resistance_army.description: Attacking units have +1 <statuseffectresistance></statuseffectresistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

boonoflife.name: Boon of Nature
boonoflife.description: Whenever an attacking unit starts their turn in a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FloraObstacleConcept]Flora Obstacle[/hyperlink], they gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FORTUNE]Fortune[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink].

bringer_of_judgement.name: Bringer of Judgment
bringer_of_judgement.description: Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ARCHONS_SMITE]Archon's Smite[/hyperlink] for the duration of this combat.

burning.name: Burning
burning.description: At the start of battle, all attacking units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

chained_basilisk.name: Chained Basilisk
chained_basilisk.description: The Primordial Basilisk starts the battle [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

chaotic_rebuke_army.name: Chaotic Rebuke Attackers
chaotic_rebuke_army.description: All attacking units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHAOTIC_REBUKE_PROPERTY_GROUP]Chaotic Rebuke[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

cinder_storm.name: Cinder Storm
cinder_storm.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], the Primordial Moth flaps its wings, causing one of the attacking units to become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

cinren01.name: Cinren's Amusement
cinren01.description: Every turn, a random attacker non-hero unit has a base 90% chance of becoming [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

clay_rebirth.name: Created by primordial flames
clay_rebirth.description: The defending clay soldiers gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIERY_REBIRTH]Fiery Rebirth[/hyperlink].

combat_casters.name: Melee Mage Defenders
combat_casters.description: All defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MELEE_MAGE]Melee Mage[/hyperlink] until the end of the battle.

condemned_army.name: Confessed and Condemned
condemned_army.description: All attacking units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONDEMNED]Condemned[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

corrupted_souls.name: Corrupted Souls
corrupted_souls.description: When a defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] Unit dies, they resurrect as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.CORRUPT_SOUL]Corrupt Soul[/hyperlink] after 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

crashing_rubble.name: Crashing Rubble
crashing_rubble.description: Every 2 <turn></turn>, a marker is placed. Then, after 1 <turn></turn> burning debris will crash down, and units within 1 <range></range> of the marker will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> and 10 <damageFire></damageFire>. The target hexes will gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].

curse_of_the_gorgon.name: Gorgon's Curse
curse_of_the_gorgon.description: At the start of battle, a unit is secretly chosen to be the target of the curse. This target will become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] in 2 <turn></turn> if it is still alive, and a new target will then be chosen.

curse_of_the_gorgon_visible.name: Gorgon's Visible Curse
curse_of_the_gorgon_visible.description:
At the start of battle, a unit is secretly chosen to be the target of the curse. This target will become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] in 2 if it is still alive, and a new target will then be chosen.

You can see who the target of the curse is.

damaged_enemies.name: Damaged Defenders
damaged_enemies.description: Defending units suffer 20 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> at the start of combat.

delayed_displacing_reality.name: Delayed Displaced Reality
delayed_displacing_reality.description: Every 3 <turn></turn>, all units are teleported by 2 hexes.

delayed_surge.name: Delayed Volatile Surge
delayed_surge.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all attacking units have 60% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLATILE_CHARGE]Volatile Charge[/hyperlink].

delayed_unnatural_evolution.name: Delayed Unnatural Evolution
delayed_unnatural_evolution.description:
Every 3 , a defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAGON]Dragon[/hyperlink] unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARKED_FOR_EVOLUTION]Marked for Evolution[/hyperlink].

When it expires, the unit transforms into a greater [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAGON]Dragon[/hyperlink] unit until the end of combat.

delayed_worm.name: Delayed Tremors
delayed_worm.description: Every 4 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], a 2-hex radius near an attacking Unit becomes marked by tremors.<bulletlist><bullet>All attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] in the radius suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> Turn.</bullet><bullet>At the end of the next <turn></turn> Turn, all Units still inside the radius are killed.<bulletlist><bullet>Units killed this way ignore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RESURGENCE]Resurgence[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink] and do not leave behind a corpse.</bullet><bullet>The Expedition Leader is still revived at 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] if their side is victorious in battle.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

demon_summoning.name: Demonic Summoning
demon_summoning.description: In 5 <turn></turn>, a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BALOR]Balor[/hyperlink] will be summoned on the defender's side.

demon_summoning_delayed.name: Delayed Demonic Summoning
demon_summoning_delayed.description: In 8 <turn></turn>, a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BALOR]Balor[/hyperlink] will be summoned on the defender's side.

demon_summoning_hastened.name: Hastened Demonic Summoning
demon_summoning_hastened.description: In 3 <turn></turn>, a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BALOR]Balor[/hyperlink] will be summoned on the defender's side.

demon_summoning_seized.name: Seized Demonic Summoning
demon_summoning_seized.description: The attacker has seized control of the ritual! In 5 <turn></turn>, a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.BALOR]Balor[/hyperlink] with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] will join the attacker until the end of battle.

discouraged.name: Discouraged Attackers
discouraged.description: All attacking units have -10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

discouraged_enemies.name: Discouraged Defenders
discouraged_enemies.description: All defending units have -10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

disperse_defenders.name: Disperse Defenders
disperse_defenders.description: At the start of combat, half of the defending Lithorine units become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HASTENED]Hastened[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] and half of them become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

disperse_mist.name: Disperse Mist
disperse_mist.description: Summon winds to disperse 50% of the mist clouds.

displacing_reality.name: Displaced Reality
displacing_reality.description: Every 2 <turn></turn>, all units are teleported by 2 hexes.

distracted_army.name: Distracted Attackers
distracted_army.description: All attacking units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISTRACTED]Distracted[/hyperlink] until the end of the battle.

draconic_catalyst.name: Draconic Catalyst
draconic_catalyst.description:
When a Red Dragon has [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRACONIC_RAGE]Draconic Rage[/hyperlink], all attacking units have a 90% chance to suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink] every turn.

When a Blue Dragon has [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRACONIC_RAGE]Draconic Rage[/hyperlink], all attacking units have a 60% chance to get [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink] every turn.

echoing_acoustics.name: Reverberant Acoustics
echoing_acoustics.description: All [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SHRIEKING_BAT]Shrieking Bats[/hyperlink] have their attacks affect all targets in a 1-hex area of their primary target and have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMOLISHER]Demolisher[/hyperlink].

elemental_fragility.name: Elemental Fragility
elemental_fragility.description: The first time each defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL]Elemental[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] falls below 50% of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>The Unit teleports up to 3 hexes away from attackers.</bullet><bullet>The Unit transforms into a random other Elemental Unit.</bullet><bullet>The Unit suffers 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_DEFENSE]Sundered Defense[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

elemental_mayhem.name: Elemental Mayhem
elemental_mayhem.description: The first time each defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ELEMENTAL]Elemental[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] falls below 50% of its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink]:<bulletlist><bullet>The Unit teleports up to 3 hexes away from attackers.</bullet><bullet>The Unit transforms into a random other Tier 1 Elemental Unit.</bullet><bullet>The Unit is healed for 20 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink]</bullet></bulletlist>

embodiment_of_light.name: Embodiment of Light
embodiment_of_light.description: Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HOLY_AURA_ENCHANTMENT_PROPERTY_GROUP]Holy Aura[/hyperlink] during battle.

encouraged.name: Encouraged Attackers
encouraged.description: All attacking units have +10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

encouraged_enemies.name: Encouraged Defenders
encouraged_enemies.description: All defending units have +10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

eternalservants.name: Undead Servants
eternalservants.description:
Undead Servants fight to protect the Undead Queen!

All defending units resurrect 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] after being killed for the first time.

Destroying the defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HeroConcept]Hero[/hyperlink] instantly kills all enemies.

fading_souls.name: Fading Souls
fading_souls.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all corpses of defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are resurrected as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PHANTASM_WARRIOR_UNIT]Phantasm Warrior[/hyperlink] which dies after 3 <turn></turn> Turns.

fire_immunity.name: Immunity to Burning Attackers
fire_immunity.description: Until the end of battle, all attacking units are immune to suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink]

firestarter.name: Rampant Fire
firestarter.description: Several areas and flammable obstacles are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].

fracturing_dragon.name: Fracturing Wake
fracturing_dragon.description: The defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FRACTURED_DRAGON]Fractured Dragon[/hyperlink] leaves behind Mana Fractures on each hex targeted by its attacks. Mana Fractures have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DrainingConcept]Draining[/hyperlink] and spread to an adjacent hex every time a Spell is cast.

fragmented_bloodlight_reflections.name: Fragmented Bloodstone Reflections
fragmented_bloodlight_reflections.description:
Every [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], a few positions gain Bloodlight for 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] units in Bloodlight gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REGENERATION]Regeneration[/hyperlink] at the end of the Turn.

free_souls.name: Free Their Souls
free_souls.description: Attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]Support Unit[/hyperlink] units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FREE_THEIR_SOULS]Free Their Souls[/hyperlink] during battle.

freezing_winds.name: Freezing Winds
freezing_winds.description: Every 3 <turn></turn>, all attacking units suffer 10 <damageFrost></damageFrost> and have 30% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FROZEN]Frozen[/hyperlink]. If it fails, the units suffers [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CHILLED]Chilled[/hyperlink] instead.

friendly_fire_worm.name: Agitated Tremors
friendly_fire_worm.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], a 2-hex radius near a defending Unit becomes marked by tremors.<bulletlist><bullet>All attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] in the radius suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> Turn.</bullet><bullet>At the end of the next Turn, all Units still inside the radius are killed.<bulletlist><bullet>Units killed this way ignore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RESURGENCE]Resurgence[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink] and do not leave behind a corpse.</bullet><bullet>The Expedition Leader is still revived at 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] if their side is victorious in battle.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

friendly_transformation_astral_attunemen.name: Glint of Astral Attunement
friendly_transformation_astral_attunemen.description: All attacking units of a race are affected by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AstralAttunementConcept]Astral Attunement[/hyperlink] major race transformation for the duration of this combat.

frigid_winds.name: Frigid Winds
frigid_winds.description: After a Lightning from the Lightning Storm strikes, all defending units are dealt 5 <damageFrost></damageFrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostDamageConcept]Frost Damage[/hyperlink].

frikka01.name: Mirrored Army
frikka01.description:
At the start of the battle, each Defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] transforms into a non-[hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HERO]Hero[/hyperlink] attacking unit that hasn't been copied yet.
In addition, after 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], each attacking Hero Unit spawns a hostile clone of itself within 3 hexes.

frikka02.name: Piglet Imitation
frikka02.description: After 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] permanently transforms into a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PIGLET]Piglet[/hyperlink].

giant_slaying_legend.name: Giant Slaying Legend
giant_slaying_legend.description: The [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SKILLS.HUNTERS_CROSSBOW_SKILL]Giant Slayer[/hyperlink] property.

giant_worm.name: Gargantuan Tremors
giant_worm.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], a 2-hex radius near an attacking Unit becomes marked by tremors.<bulletlist><bullet>All attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] in the radius suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> Turn.</bullet><bullet>At the end of the next <turn></turn> Turn, all Units still inside the radius are killed.<bulletlist><bullet>Units killed this way ignore [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RESURGENCE]Resurgence[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink] and do not leave behind a corpse.</bullet><bullet>The Expedition Leader is still revived at 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] if their side is victorious in battle.</bullet></bulletlist></bullet></bulletlist>

giants_blessing.name: Giant's Blessing
giants_blessing.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the defending units that hasn't been targeted yet gains the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPERGROWTH_PROPERTY_GROUP]Supergrowth[/hyperlink] <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept]Race Transformation[/hyperlink] and heals to full [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].

giants_judgement.name: Giant's Judgment
giants_judgement.description: Your Giant Ruler's attacks inflict [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.REMORSE]Remorse[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

gorging_predators.name: Gorging Predators
gorging_predators.description: All defending units have the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VIOLENT_GORGING]Violent Gorging[/hyperlink] ability.

hastened_army.name: Hastened Attackers
hastened_army.description: At the start of battle, all attacking units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HASTENED]Hastened[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn>.

hastening_storm.name: Hastening Storm
hastening_storm.description: At the start of a turn, for the next 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] a random attacking unit takes 24 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink], but also becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HASTENED]Hastened[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

hidden_traps.name: Hidden Traps
hidden_traps.description:
Several hidden traps are scattered on the map! If a unit moves over them, it will be inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLEEDING]Bleeding[/hyperlink] for 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] and reveal the trap!

Does not affect [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] units.

immumeseduced.name: Immune to Seduced
immumeseduced.description: All attacking units are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMUMESEDUCED]Immune to Seduced[/hyperlink] until the end of battle!

joining_the_fun.name: Joining the Fun
joining_the_fun.description: Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PAINBOUND_PROPERTY_GROUP]Painbound[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CURSE_EATER]Curse Eater[/hyperlink] until the end of the battle.

karissa01.name: Karissa's Curse
karissa01.description: When a non-hero attacker dies, it turns into an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.IMMOLATED_SOUL]Immolated Soul[/hyperlink] on the defender's side.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STEADFAST]Steadfast[/hyperlink] for <eventColor>turn</eventColor> <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] the first time they fall below 10% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].

leeching_from_nature.name: Nature Leeching
leeching_from_nature.description: The defending Horned God is leeching power from the surrounding nature. Each <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], all [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FloraObstacleConcept]Flora Obstacle[/hyperlink] obstacles within a 2-hex range are consumed, healing the Horned God +10 <hp></hp> and granting 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STRENGTHENED]Strengthened[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

lightning_resistance.name: Advanced Lightning Protection
lightning_resistance.description: Until the end of combat, the defending units gain additional Lightning Protection.

lightning_storm.name: Lightning Storm
lightning_storm.description: At the start of a turn, for the next 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] a random attacking unit takes 24 <damageLightning></damageLightning> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LightningDamageConcept]Lightning Damage[/hyperlink].

lithorite_disruption.name: Lithorite Disruption
lithorite_disruption.description: Half of the defending Lithorine units start the battle [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

lithorite_recombination.name: Stoneshard Recycling
lithorite_recombination.description: While the Primordial Bloodback is alive, whenever a defending Lithorine Tier 1 - Tier 3 Unit dies, if there is another Lithorine Corpse on the map, resurrect that one as a Lithorine unit that is 1 tier higher than the Lithorine unit that just died.

lost_puppeteer.name: Dark Whispers
lost_puppeteer.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], one of the attacker's units becomes permanently [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIND_CONTROLLED]Final Ultimatum[/hyperlink].

lost_puppeteer_immunity.name: Faithful Loyalty
lost_puppeteer_immunity.description: Attacker units that are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FAITHFUL]Faithful[/hyperlink] gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept]Control Loss Immunity[/hyperlink].

lost_puppeteer_reverse.name: Cut Strings
lost_puppeteer_reverse.description: After the first 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], force one of the defending units to become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIND_CONTROLLED]Final Ultimatum[/hyperlink] and fight for you.

lost_puppeteer_stun.name: Control Wards
lost_puppeteer_stun.description: Attacker units that become [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MIND_CONTROLLED]Final Ultimatum[/hyperlink] are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].

lost_puppeteer_stun_single.name: Break Control
lost_puppeteer_stun_single.description: At the start of combat, the second strongest unit in the defending army becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] for 6 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]

mass_spawning.name: Spawn First Wave
mass_spawning.description: A wave of 2 additional defending units will spawn in 2 <turn></turn>!

mass_spawning2.name: Mass Spawning: Second Wave
mass_spawning2.description: A wave of 2 additional defending units will spawn in 4 <turn></turn>!

mass_spawning3.name: Mass Spawning: Third Wave
mass_spawning3.description: A wave of 2 additional defending units will spawn in 6 <turn></turn>!

misty_magic.name: Misty Magic
misty_magic.description: [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept]Obscuring[/hyperlink] Mist covers the battlefield, giving all units standing in the mist +5 <resistance></resistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept]Resistance[/hyperlink], but attacking units also gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISTRACTED]Distracted[/hyperlink].

moving_sandstorms.name: Creeping Sandstorms
moving_sandstorms.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] several 1-hex radius Sandstorms are spawned in random locations.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] and have 90% of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> Turn when passing through or ending their Turn in a Sandstorm.</bullet><bullet>Sandstorms last for 2 <turn></turn> Turns.</bullet></bulletlist>

nimue01.name: Dire Queen
nimue01.description: <bulletlist><bullet>The defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.COLOSSAL_PENGUIN]Colossal Penguin[/hyperlink] has +25 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink] per defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PENGUIN]Penguin[/hyperlink] at the start of combat.</bullet><bullet>Whenever a defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PENGUIN]Penguin[/hyperlink] dies, the defending Colossal Penguin loses 25 <hp></hp> Hit Points.</bullet></bulletlist>

noctus01.name: Graven Strength
noctus01.description: When an [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDEAD]Undead[/hyperlink] unit is resurrected they gain:<bulletlist><bullet>+20% damage.</bullet><bullet>+10 maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

noctus03.name: Stolen Power
noctus03.description: At the start of combat 2 Skeleton units join the attackers.

omni_attunement.name: Omni Attunement
omni_attunement.description: The defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LOST_WIZARD_UNIT]Lost Wizard[/hyperlink] hungers for forbidden knowledge and ancient spells. Every time a Spell is cast, it gains 3 random [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept]Positive Status Effects[/hyperlink].

opened_cooling_vents.name: Cooling Vents
opened_cooling_vents.description: Cool moisture is passing through the opened vents! Standing on vents will make units [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.WET]Wet[/hyperlink] and can dispel [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink].

oracles_help.name: Oracles Help
oracles_help.description: An [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.ORACLE]Oracle[/hyperlink] unit joins you at the start of the battle.

order_of_glutton.name: Gluttonous Power
order_of_glutton.description: The Karagh gains the ability to consume the piles of bones scattered around the map. Consuming a pile gives the Karagh a stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.COMBATPROPERTY_DEVOURED_POWER]Devoured Power[/hyperlink].

order_of_glutton_condemn.name: Condemned Defenders
order_of_glutton_condemn.description: All defending units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONDEMNED]Condemned[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

order_of_glutton_no_gorging.name: Unappetizing
order_of_glutton_no_gorging.description: The Karagh cannot use its [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TERRIFYING_GORGING]Terrifying Gorging[/hyperlink] ability.

order_of_glutton_poison.name: Poisoned Food
order_of_glutton_poison.description: Poison the Karaghs' food, making the Karagh gain 1 stack of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISEASED]Diseased[/hyperlink] whenever eating a crate of food.

out_of_control_storm.name: Storm Manipulation
out_of_control_storm.description: For the first 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], the Lightning Storm will only target the defending units.

overgrown_bush_garden.name: Overgrown Bush Garden
overgrown_bush_garden.description: Instead of additional Creeping Rosevine obstacles, additional Bush obstacles are present during the battle, which are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept]Obscuring[/hyperlink].

overgrown_rose_garden.name: Overgrown Rose Garden
overgrown_rose_garden.description: Additional Creeping Rosevine obstacles are present during the battle. They are [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SharpConcept]Sharp[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CreepingConcept]Creeping[/hyperlink].

pleasure_from_pain.name: Pleasure from Pain
pleasure_from_pain.description: All defending units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CURSE_EATER]Curse Eater[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PAINBOUND_PROPERTY_GROUP]Painbound[/hyperlink].

poison_antidotes.name: Poison Antidotes
poison_antidotes.description: Until the end of combat, all support abilities from attacking units will dispel [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink] on the target(s).

poisoned_tree.name: Poisoned Tree
poisoned_tree.description:
This tree has been affected by a plague and is secreting poison!
All Flora obstacles are poisonous.Every 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all attacking units have a 90% base chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.POISONED]Poisoned[/hyperlink] for 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink].

predictable.name: Miscalculating Targeting
predictable.description: Defending units always attack the closest enemy units, and suffer -40% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept]<accuracy></accuracy> Accuracy[/hyperlink] on their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RangedConcept]Missile[/hyperlink] attacks.

predicted_crashing_rubble.name: Predictable Crashing Rubble
predicted_crashing_rubble.description: Every 1 <turn></turn>, a marker is placed. Then, after 2 <turn></turn> burning debris will crash down, and units within 1 <range></range> of the marker will suffer 10 <damagePhysical></damagePhysical> and 10 <damageFire></damageFire>. The target hexes will gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.OnFireConcept]On Fire[/hyperlink].

prima_materia_attack_rebirth.name: Lesser Rebirth
prima_materia_attack_rebirth.description: All attacking Tier 1 - Tier 3 units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIERY_REBIRTH]Fiery Rebirth[/hyperlink].

prima_materia_fire_res.name: Advanced Fire Protection
prima_materia_fire_res.description: All attacking units start combat with +4 <defensefire></defensefire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireResistanceConcept]Fire Protection[/hyperlink].

prima_materia_gilded.name: Gilded Construct
prima_materia_gilded.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], a Golem on the defending side becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GILDED]Gilded[/hyperlink].

prima_materia_no_fire.name: Cooled Reconstruction
prima_materia_no_fire.description: All defending Golems gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIERY_REBIRTH]Fiery Rebirth[/hyperlink], but the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIERY_REBIRTH]Fiery Rebirth[/hyperlink] deals no <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].

prima_materia_retaliation.name: Retrain Troops
prima_materia_retaliation.description: All attacking units gain extra [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HS_DEFENSE_DEFENSE]Enhanced Defense[/hyperlink] against Retaliation Attacks.

prophecy_of_death.name: Prophecy of Death
prophecy_of_death.description: At the start of combat, the enemy oracle inflicts [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARKED_FOR_DEATH]Visions of Death[/hyperlink] on your leader. This effect lasts until the end of combat, but can be dispelled if the oracle is killed.

puny_slaying.name: Puny Slaying
puny_slaying.description: All defending units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PUNY_SLAYER]Puny Slayer[/hyperlink] until the end of combat.

rampant_flora.name: Rampant Flora
rampant_flora.description: There are several extra [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ObscuringConcept]Obscuring[/hyperlink] Flora Obstacles present in combat.

rejuvinating_souls.name: Rejuvenating Souls
rejuvinating_souls.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all corpses of defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are resurrected as a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PHANTASM_WARRIOR_UNIT]Phantasm Warrior[/hyperlink]. When this happens, all attacking units within a 2-hex radius of the corpse are healed for 10 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept]<temphp></temphp> Temporary Hit Points[/hyperlink].

revealed_traps.name: Revealed Traps
revealed_traps.description:
Several traps have been revealed on the map! If a unit moves over them, it will be inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLEEDING]Bleeding[/hyperlink] for 3 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] and reveal the trap!

Does not affect [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLOATING_MOVEMENT]Floating[/hyperlink], [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FLYING_MOVEMENT]Flying[/hyperlink], or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ETHEREAL]Ethereal[/hyperlink] units.

reverse_growth.name: Puny Curse
reverse_growth.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], one of the defending units that hasn't been targeted yet gains the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SPAWNKIN_PROPERTY_GROUP]Spawnkin[/hyperlink] <caststrategic></caststrategic> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept]Race Transformation[/hyperlink] and has their Maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Point[/hyperlink] reduced by 20.

righteous_martyr.name: Righteous Martyr
righteous_martyr.description: Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARTYRS_REBIRTH]Ascended Martyrdom[/hyperlink] during combat.

sabotaged_constructs.name: Sabotaged Constructs
sabotaged_constructs.description: All defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONSTRUCT]Construct[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_DEFENSE]Sundered Defense[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink]. All defending Non-Construct Units suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DEMORALIZED]Demoralized[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn> Turns instead.

silver_knight.name: Duelist's Protection
silver_knight.description: The duelist takes reduced damage from all units, except from the stack leader of the opposing army.

silver_knight_taunt.name: Taunting the Knight
silver_knight_taunt.description: The attacking armies [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITIONLEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TAUNT]Taunts[/hyperlink] the Silver Knight until the end of the battle.

skeleton_summon_on_death.name: Haunted Coffins
skeleton_summon_on_death.description: Whenever a Sarcophagus obstacle is destroyed, it summons a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SKELETON_UNIT]Skeleton Militia[/hyperlink] on the defender's side until the end of combat.

slave_revolt.name: Escaped Animals
slave_revolt.description: At the start of battle, a couple of War Hound units inflicted with [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BERSERK]Berserk[/hyperlink] join the fight adjacent to defending units.

sleeper_in_shadow.name: Dead King's presence
sleeper_in_shadow.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], 1 attacking unit is targeted; if it has [hyperlink,GLOBAL.LowMoraleConcept]Low Morale[/hyperlink], it gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INSANITY]Insanity[/hyperlink], otherwise it loses 10 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink].

sleeper_in_shadow_distracted.name: Slow Immunity
sleeper_in_shadow_distracted.description: Become immune to the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] effect of the Dead King, but start combat [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISTRACTED]Distracted[/hyperlink].

sleeper_in_shadow_frost_resistance.name: Frost Protection
sleeper_in_shadow_frost_resistance.description: All attacking units start combat with +4 <defensefrost></defensefrost> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FrostResistanceConcept]Frost Protection[/hyperlink].

sleeper_in_shadow_rally.name: Rallying support
sleeper_in_shadow_rally.description: The supporting abilities of attackers give a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.RALLYING]Rally[/hyperlink] effect.

sleeper_in_shadow_slowed.name: Lethargy
sleeper_in_shadow_slowed.description: The Dead King inflicts [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] on hits.

sleeper_insane_immunity.name: Mentally Stable
sleeper_insane_immunity.description: All attacking units are immune to [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.INSANITY]Insanity[/hyperlink].

slowed_army.name: Slowed Attackers
