slowed_army.description: At the start of battle, all attacking units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn>.

slowed_enemies.name: Slowed Defenders
slowed_enemies.description: At the start of battle, all defending units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] for 3 <turn></turn>.

slumbering_souls.name: Stirring Skeletons
slumbering_souls.description:
Each 1 , one attacking unit becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HAUNTED]Haunted[/hyperlink].

If a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HAUNTED]Haunted[/hyperlink] unit stands adjacent to a Sarcophagus obstacle, the Sarcophagus is destroyed and will summon a Skeleton [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] on the defender's side.

slumbering_souls_delayed.name: Delayed Stirring Skeletons
slumbering_souls_delayed.description:
Each 2 , one attacking unit becomes [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HAUNTED]Haunted[/hyperlink].

If a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.HAUNTED]Haunted[/hyperlink] unit stands adjacent to a Sarcophagus obstacle, the Sarcophagus is destroyed and will summon a Skeleton [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Unit[/hyperlink] on the defender's side.

soulbinder.name: Soulbinder
soulbinder.description: Your [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SOULBINDERS_GROUP]Souldraining Strikes[/hyperlink] on their attacks during battle.

spiderlair.name: Sprawling Spiderwebs
spiderlair.description: At the start of combat, several [hyperlink,GLOBAL.SlowingConcept]Slowing[/hyperlink] Spider Web obstacles are present.

splitting_magma.name: Magma Split
splitting_magma.description: When a defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.MAGMA_SPIRIT]Magma Spirit[/hyperlink] is killed, it spawns 1 [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LESSER_MAGMA_SPIRIT]Lesser Magma Spirit[/hyperlink].

stand_together.name: Together We Stand
stand_together.description: All attacking units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STAND_TOGETHER]Stand Together[/hyperlink] until the end of combat.

star_reading.name: Star Reading
star_reading.description: All attacking units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TRUE_STRIKE]True Strike[/hyperlink] at the start of combat.

static_sandstorms.name: Static Sandstorms
static_sandstorms.description: Several 1-hex radius Sandstorms are present in battle.<bulletlist><bullet>[hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] without [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SAND_WALK]Sand Walk[/hyperlink] suffer [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SLOWED]Slowed[/hyperlink] and have 90% of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BLINDED]Blind[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] when passing through or ending their turn in a Sandstorm.</bullet><bullet>These Sandstorms do not move and stay in their positions until the end of the battle.</bullet></bulletlist>

stoked_fire.name: Stoked Fire
stoked_fire.description: The defending clay units start combat [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BURNING]Burning[/hyperlink].

stop_undying.name: Sealed Resurrection
stop_undying.description: All defending clay soldiers are unable to use their [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.UNDYING]Undying[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.FIERY_REBIRTH]Fiery Rebirth[/hyperlink] ability.

strengthened_army.name: Strengthened Attackers
strengthened_army.description: All attacking units' attacks deal +10% damage until the end of battle.

strengthened_enemies.name: Strengthened Defenders
strengthened_enemies.description: All defending units' attacks deal +10% damage until the end of battle.

stunning_sounds.name: Stunning Sounds
stunning_sounds.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], a [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.SHRIEKING_BAT]Shrieking Bat[/hyperlink] has a 90% of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.STUNNED]Stunned[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink]. If failed, it suffers [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DISTRACTED]Distracted[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] instead.

sundered_armor_enemies.name: Defenseless Defenders
sundered_armor_enemies.description: All defending units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_DEFENSE]Sundered Defense[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

sundered_resistance_enemies.name: Vulnerable Defenders
sundered_resistance_enemies.description: All defending units have [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUNDERED_RESISTANCE]Sundered Resistance[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

sundered_status_resistance_army.name: Sundered Status Resistance Attackers
sundered_status_resistance_army.description: Attacking units have -1 <statuseffectresistance></statuseffectresistance> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept]Status Resistance[/hyperlink] until the end of battle.

supporting_divination.name: Supporting Divination
supporting_divination.description: All attacking units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.PRECOGNITION]Precognition[/hyperlink] at the start of combat.

taunted_dragon.name: Fractured Dragon Taunt
taunted_dragon.description: The defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.FRACTURED_DRAGON]Fractured Dragon[/hyperlink] is taunted by the attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] until the end of the battle!

taunted_queen.name: Taunted Queen
taunted_queen.description: The entire enemy army is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TAUNTED]Taunted[/hyperlink] by the attacking [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.EXPEDITION_LEADER]Expedition Leader[/hyperlink] until the end of the battle.

taunted_sentries.name: Taunted Sentries
taunted_sentries.description: Every defending unit is [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.TAUNTED]Taunted[/hyperlink] by a random attacking unit until the end of battle.

the_one.name: The Wailing
the_one.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], the attacker's units lose 5 morale.

the_untouchables.name: The Untouchables
the_untouchables.description:
The defenders have forced the Oracles to bring forth prophecies to make their army untouchable.
Each turn of combat a different prophecy will come into effect in order:

tome_fey_mist_skill4_prop_name.name: Misty
tome_fey_mist_skill4_prop_name.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] during combat, various [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MistConcept]Mist[/hyperlink] clouds appear.

undying_souls.name: Undying Souls
undying_souls.description: Every 3 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all corpses of defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] are resurrected as [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.PHANTASM_WARRIOR_UNIT]Phantasm Warriors[/hyperlink].

unnatural_evolution.name: Unnatural Evolution
unnatural_evolution.description:
Every 2 , a defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAGON]Dragon[/hyperlink] unit gains [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.MARKED_FOR_EVOLUTION]Marked for Evolution[/hyperlink].

When it expires, the unit transforms into a greater [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.ANIMAL]Animal[/hyperlink] or [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.DRAGON]Dragon[/hyperlink] unit until the end of combat.

volatile_constructs.name: Volatile Constructs
volatile_constructs.description: Defending [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.CONSTRUCT]Construct[/hyperlink] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitConcept]Units[/hyperlink] explode on death, dealing 20 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink] to all adjacent defending Units.

volatile_surge.name: Volatile Surge
volatile_surge.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], all attacking units have 60% chance of suffering [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.VOLATILE_CHARGE]Volatile Charge[/hyperlink].

weakened_enemies.name: Weakened Defenders
weakened_enemies.description: All defending units' attacks deal -10% damage until the end of battle.

withering_garden.name: Withering Garden
withering_garden.description: Every <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink], each Creeping Rosevine has a 50% chance of being destroyed.

yaka01.name: Slavers
yaka01.description: Defender [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.BATTLE_MAGE]Battle Mage Unit[/hyperlink] and [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUPPORT_UNIT]Support Unit[/hyperlink] units gain [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.SUBDUE_PANTHEON]Subdue[/hyperlink]. Other units gain a base 30% [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.IMMOBILIZED]Immobilized[/hyperlink] chance on their base attacks, increased for Single Shot.

yaka02.name: Defection
yaka02.description: At the start of combat, a random defender defects to the attackers.

yaka03.name: Yaka's Power
yaka03.description: The base attacks of units in the attackers side:<bulletlist><bullet>Gain +2 <damageFire></damageFire> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.FireDamageConcept]Fire Damage[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Deal 2 <happiness></happiness> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept]Morale[/hyperlink] damage.</bullet></bulletlist>Effects [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept]are increased[/hyperlink] for Single Shot attacks.

ydgaard01.name: Ydgaard's Golden Guardians
ydgaard01.description: Defender heroes:<bulletlist><bullet>Have -20 maximum [hyperlink,GLOBAL.HitPointConcept]<hp></hp> Hit Points[/hyperlink].</bullet><bullet>Base attacks have a base 30/60/70/90/120% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GILDED]Gilded[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink].</bullet></bulletlist>

ydgaard03.name: Gilded Blessing
ydgaard03.description: Attackers have a base 30/60/70/90/120% chance of inflicting [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PROPERTIES.GILDED]Gilded[/hyperlink] for 1 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turn[/hyperlink] on attacks. Increased for Single Shots.

zaethyl01.name: Grasping Flora
zaethyl01.description: Every 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink], several [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UNITS.LIVING_VINE_UNIT]Living Vines[/hyperlink] are summoned on random positions which last for 2 <turn></turn> [hyperlink,GLOBAL.TurnConcept]Turns[/hyperlink] on the defender's side.
